# Animation of flight path in game code (2026-02-05 21:11Z)

_**User (2026-02-05 21:49Z)**_

After a conversation with the lady at the travel agency (room 20), Alfred travels to Egypt. As a transition an "extra" screen is displayed, representing a map of europe and north africa. In this map there is an animation of a path being drawn signaling the route alfreds plane follows. I need to find how that animation is done in the game. 

My best guess is that this is triggered after a conversation "f8" trigger, specicifally F8 17 01 or trigger 271. But it can also be triggered by something else.

i want you to check ghidra and find where this animation lives or if its hardcoded. The animation consists of a discontinous line in which the different segments popup consecutively to form the plane's trajectory. I could not find in the resource files any animation resembling this.


---

_**Agent (model copilot/claude-opus-4.5)**_

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSearch for Egypt travel animation in game code and resources\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\n# Read JUEGO.EXE\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\n# Read ALFRED.1 (room data)\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    alfred1 = f.read()\n\nprint(\"=\"*70)\nprint(\"SEARCHING FOR EGYPT TRAVEL ANIMATION\")\nprint(\"=\"*70)\n\n# 1. Check the F8 action dispatch table for actions in room 20 range\n# F8 action dispatch table at 0x47e58 (in data segment)\n# Data segment: file offset 0x43200 = Ghidra 0x40000\ntable_ghidra = 0x47e58\ntable_file = table_ghidra - 0x40000 + 0x43200  # 0x4B058\n\nprint(\"\\n1. F8 Action Dispatch Table entries 265-285:\")\nprint(\"-\"*70)\n\noffset = 0\nfound_entries = []\nwhile True:\n    action_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', exe_data[table_file + offset:table_file + offset + 2])[0]\n    if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n        break\n    func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', exe_data[table_file + offset + 2:table_file + offset + 6])[0]\n    found_entries.append((action_id, func_ptr))\n    offset += 6\n    if offset &gt; 2000:\n        break\n\n# Sort and display\nfound_entries.sort()\nfor action_id, func_ptr in found_entries:\n    if 265 &lt;= action_id &lt;= 285 or action_id == 271:\n        print(f\"  Action {action_id:4d} (0x{action_id:04X}) -&gt; Handler 0x{func_ptr:05X}\")\n\n# 2. Search for room 20 conversation text containing F8 triggers\nprint(\"\\n2. Room 20 (Travel Agency) Conversation Data:\")\nprint(\"-\"*70)\n\n# Room directory structure: 56 rooms * 13 pairs * 8 bytes = 5824 bytes at start\n# Each pair is (offset: 4 bytes, size: 4 bytes)\nroom_20_dir_offset = 20 * 13 * 8  # Room 20 directory entry\nprint(f\"Room 20 directory at ALFRED.1 offset 0x{room_20_dir_offset:X}\")\n\n# Read room 20's 13 data pairs\nroom20_pairs = []\nfor i in range(13):\n    entry_offset = room_20_dir_offset + i * 8\n    data_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alfred1[entry_offset:entry_offset+4])[0]\n    data_size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alfred1[entry_offset+4:entry_offset+8])[0]\n    room20_pairs.append((data_offset, data_size))\n    if data_size &gt; 0:\n        print(f\"  Pair {i:2d}: offset=0x{data_offset:06X}, size={data_size:5d}\")\n\n# Pair 12 is the text/conversation data\ntext_offset, text_size = room20_pairs[12]\nprint(f\"\\nText data at 0x{text_offset:X}, size {text_size}\")\n\n# Search for F8 triggers in the conversation data\nif text_size &gt; 0:\n    text_data = alfred1[text_offset:text_offset + text_size]\n    print(f\"\\nSearching for F8 triggers in room 20 text data...\")\n    \n    f8_triggers = []\n    for i in range(len(text_data) - 2):\n        if text_data[i] == 0xF8:\n            param1 = text_data[i+1]\n            param2 = text_data[i+2]\n            action_id = param1 | (param2 &lt;&lt; 8)\n            f8_triggers.append((i, action_id))\n    \n    print(f\"Found {len(f8_triggers)} F8 triggers:\")\n    for offset, action_id in f8_triggers:\n        print(f\"  Offset 0x{offset:04X}: F8 action {action_id} (0x{action_id:04X})\")\n\n# 3. Look for special screens or animations\nprint(\"\\n3. Looking for special transition animations...\")\nprint(\"-\"*70)\n\n# Search for functions that might do screen transitions\n# Common patterns: load a background, draw lines, delay\n\n# Let's check if there's a special room for the map screen\n# Room 57-58 might be special rooms\nprint(\"\\nChecking for extra rooms (56+)...\")\nfor room_num in range(55, 60):\n    if room_num &gt;= 56:\n        print(f\"  Room {room_num}: Beyond normal room range (56 rooms total)\")\n        continue\n    room_dir_offset = room_num * 13 * 8\n    pairs = []\n    for i in range(13):\n        entry_offset = room_dir_offset + i * 8\n        data_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alfred1[entry_offset:entry_offset+4])[0]\n        data_size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alfred1[entry_offset+4:entry_offset+8])[0]\n        if data_size &gt; 0:\n            pairs.append((i, data_offset, data_size))\n    if pairs:\n        print(f\"  Room {room_num}: {len(pairs)} data pairs\")\n\n# 4. Search for draw_line function calls\nprint(\"\\n4. Searching for line drawing code references...\")\nprint(\"-\"*70)\n\n# draw_line is at 0x29c34 in Ghidra\n# Search for CALL instructions to this address\ndraw_line_addr = 0x29c34\n# In x86, near call is E8 XX XX XX XX (relative offset)\n# Far call or call through pointer uses different encoding\n\n# Search for the address in code\naddr_bytes = struct.pack('&lt;I', draw_line_addr)\ncode_start = 0x14200  # Code segment file start\ncode_end = 0x43200    # Code segment file end\n\nprint(f\"Looking for calls to draw_line (0x{draw_line_addr:X})...\")\n\n# Actually, search for any reference to the address\npositions = []\npos = code_start\nwhile pos &lt; code_end:\n    found = exe_data.find(addr_bytes, pos, code_end)\n    if found == -1:\n        break\n    positions.append(found)\n    pos = found + 1\n\nif positions:\n    print(f\"Found {len(positions)} references:\")\n    for pos in positions:\n        ghidra_addr = pos - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n        context = exe_data[pos-8:pos+8]\n        print(f\"  0x{ghidra_addr:05X}: {' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in context)}\")\nelse:\n    print(\"No direct references found\")\n\n# 5. Let's look at what loads after room 20 conversation ends\nprint(\"\\n5. Checking load_room_and_init_alfred for special cases...\")\nprint(\"-\"*70)\n\n# The function load_room_and_init_alfred is at 0x152f5\n# Let's look for special room handling there\nfunc_addr = 0x152f5\nfunc_file = func_addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200  # 0x194F5\nfunc_bytes = exe_data[func_file:func_file + 500]\n\nprint(f\"load_room_and_init_alfred at 0x{func_addr:X}:\")\nprint(f\"First 100 bytes: {' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in func_bytes[:100])}\")\n",

0 and text_offset &lt; len(data):\n        text_data = data[text_offset:text_offset + text_size]\n        \n        # Search for F8 0x0F 0x01 (action 271 = 0x010F)\n        for i in range(len(text_data) - 2):\n            if text_data[i] == 0xF8:\n                action_low = text_data[i+1]\n                action_high = text_data[i+2]\n                action_id = action_low | (action_high &lt;&lt; 8)\n                \n                if action_id == 271:\n                    print(f\"Room {room_num:2d}: F8 action 271 at text offset 0x{i:04X}\")\n                    # Print context\n                    start = max(0, i - 20)\n                    end = min(len(text_data), i + 20)\n                    context = text_data[start:end]\n                    print(f\"  Context: {context}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\"*70)\nprint(\"Also searching for action 271 handler calls...\")\nprint(\"=\"*70)\n\n# Now search the EXE for any direct call/jump to handler 271 (0x11221)\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\nhandler_addr = 0x11221\ncode_start = 0x14200\ncode_end = 0x43200\n\n# Calculate call relative offsets\nfor pos in range(code_start, code_end - 5):\n    # E8 = near call\n    if exe_data[pos] == 0xE8:\n        rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', exe_data[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n        target = (pos - code_start + 0x10000) + 5 + rel  # Ghidra address of target\n        if target == handler_addr:\n            caller = pos - code_start + 0x10000\n            print(f\"  CALL to 0x{handler_addr:05X} from 0x{caller:05X}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\"*70)\nprint(\"Searching for room transition to 45 (Egypt)...\")\nprint(\"=\"*70)\n\n# Search for places that set next_room to 45\n# The pattern would be writing 45 (0x2D) to the room number variable\nroom_var_addr = 0x4FB94  # current_room_number\nroom_var_bytes = struct.pack('&lt;I', room_var_addr)\n\n# Look for C6 05 94 FB 04 00 2D = mov byte ptr [0x4FB94], 0x2D\ntarget_pattern = bytes([0xC6, 0x05]) + room_var_bytes + bytes([0x2D])\n\npos = code_start\nwhile pos &lt; code_end:\n    found = exe_data.find(target_pattern, pos, code_end)\n    if found == -1:\n        break\n    ghidra_addr = found - code_start + 0x10000\n    print(f\"  mov byte [current_room_number], 45 at 0x{ghidra_addr:05X}\")\n    pos = found + 1\n\n# Also look for places that call load_room_and_init_alfred with 45\n# This would be: push 45 (0x2D) then call load_room_and_init_alfred\nload_room_addr = 0x152F5\nprint(f\"\\nSearching for load_room_and_init_alfred(45)...\")\n\nfor pos in range(code_start, code_end - 10):\n    # 6A 2D = push 0x2D (45)\n    if exe_data[pos] == 0x6A and exe_data[pos+1] == 0x2D:\n        # Check if followed by E8 (call)\n        if exe_data[pos+2] == 0xE8:\n            rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', exe_data[pos+3:pos+7])[0]\n            target = (pos - code_start + 0x10000) + 2 + 5 + rel\n            if abs(target - load_room_addr) &lt; 10:  # Close to load_room_and_init_alfred\n                caller = pos - code_start + 0x10000\n                print(f\"  push 45; call load_room at 0x{caller:05X}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Search for F8 action 271\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\nresults = []\n\n# Search all 56 rooms for F8 action 271\nfor room_num in range(56):\n    room_dir = room_num * 13 * 8\n    text_entry = room_dir + 12 * 8\n    text_off = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[text_entry:text_entry+4])[0]\n    text_size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[text_entry+4:text_entry+8])[0]\n    \n    if text_size &gt; 0 and text_off &lt; len(data):\n        text_data = data[text_off:text_off + text_size]\n        for i in range(len(text_data) - 2):\n            if text_data[i] == 0xF8:\n                action = text_data[i+1] | (text_data[i+2] &lt;&lt; 8)\n                if action == 271:\n                    results.append(f\"Room {room_num}: F8 action 271 at text offset 0x{i:X}\")\n\n# Write results\nwith open('action271_results.txt', 'w') as f:\n    f.write(\"F8 Action 271 Search Results\\n\")\n    f.write(\"=\"*50 + \"\\n\")\n    if results:\n        for r in results:\n            f.write(r + \"\\n\")\n    else:\n        f.write(\"No F8 action 271 triggers found in any room!\\n\")\n        f.write(\"Action 271 may be called from code, not conversation text.\\n\")\n    \n    # Also search for where handler 271 is registered\n    f.write(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*50 + \"\\n\")\n    f.write(\"Handler 271 Registration\\n\")\n    f.write(\"=\"*50 + \"\\n\")\n    \n    # F8 dispatch table at 0x47E58 (data segment)\n    # format: action_id:2, func_ptr:4 (6 bytes per entry)\n    table_off = 0x43200 + (0x47E58 - 0x40000)\n    offset = 0\n    while True:\n        action_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', exe[table_off + offset:table_off + offset + 2])[0]\n        if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n            break\n        func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', exe[table_off + offset + 2:table_off + offset + 6])[0]\n        if action_id == 271:\n            f.write(f\"Action 271 handler at 0x{func_ptr:X}\\n\")\n        offset += 6\n        if offset &gt; 3000:\n            break\n    \n    f.write(\"\\nDone!\\n\")\n\nprint(\"Results written to action271_results.txt\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze room 9 text data to find F8 271 context.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    # Read room directory\n    f.seek(0)\n    directory = []\n    for i in range(56):\n        entry = []\n        for j in range(13):\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n            entry.append((offset, size))\n        directory.append(entry)\n    \n    # Room 9 text data is pair 12 (index 12)\n    room9 = directory[9]\n    text_offset, text_size = room9[12]\n    \n    print(f'Room 9 Text Data:')\n    print(f'  Offset: 0x{text_offset:X}')\n    print(f'  Size: {text_size} bytes')\n    print()\n    \n    f.seek(text_offset)\n    text_data = f.read(text_size)\n    \n    # Search for F8 action 271 (0x10F)\n    for i in range(len(text_data) - 2):\n        if text_data[i] == 0xF8:\n            action_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', text_data[i+1:i+3])[0]\n            if action_id == 271:\n                # Get context around this\n                start = max(0, i - 80)\n                end = min(len(text_data), i + 30)\n                \n                print(f'F8 271 found at text offset 0x{i:X}:')\n                print()\n                \n                # Decode text backwards from F8 marker\n                text_start = i - 1\n                while text_start &gt; 0 and text_data[text_start] &gt;= 0x20 and text_data[text_start] &lt; 0xF0:\n                    text_start -= 1\n                text_start += 1  # Skip the control byte\n                \n                # Decode the Spanish text\n                text_bytes = text_data[text_start:i]\n                try:\n                    text = text_bytes.decode('cp850', errors='replace')\n                    print(f'  Preceding text: \"{text}\"')\n                except:\n                    print(f'  Preceding bytes: {text_bytes.hex()}')\n                \n                print()\n                \n                # Show what comes after F8 271\n                after_f8 = text_data[i:i+20]\n                print(f'  After F8 271: {after_f8.hex()}')\n                \n                # Decode control codes\n                print()\n                print('  Control sequence breakdown:')\n                pos = i\n                while pos &lt; min(len(text_data), i + 20):\n                    b = text_data[pos]\n                    if b == 0xF8:\n                        action = struct.unpack('&lt;H', text_data[pos+1:pos+3])[0]\n                        print(f'    0x{pos-i:02X}: F8 {action} (0x{action:03X}) - Execute action')\n                        pos += 3\n                    elif b == 0xFD:\n                        print(f'    0x{pos-i:02X}: FD - End of text block')\n                        pos += 1\n                        break\n                    elif b == 0xF5:\n                        room = text_data[pos+1]\n                        print(f'    0x{pos-i:02X}: F5 {room} - Change to room {room}')\n                        pos += 2\n                    elif b &gt;= 0xF0:\n                        print(f'    0x{pos-i:02X}: {b:02X} - Control code')\n                        pos += 1\n                    else:\n                        pos += 1\n\nprint()\nprint('Analysis complete!')\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "# Egypt Travel Animation Analysis\n\n## Summary\n\nThe Egypt travel animation is triggered by F8 action 271, which sets up sprite animation\nparameters in the room sprite data structure.\n\n## Key Findings\n\n### 1. Handler Location\n- **Ghidra Address**: 0x11221\n- **File Offset**: 0x15421 (JUEGO.EXE)\n- **Type**: Inline code block (not a named function in Ghidra)\n- **Size**: ~358 bytes (handlers 271-272 are contiguous)\n\n### 2. Trigger Source\n- **Room**: 9 (NOT Room 20 as initially assumed)\n- **Trigger**: F8 control code in conversation text at offset 0x16\n- **Context Text**: \"¡Cómo trabaja!\" (\"How it works!\")\n- **Conversation Flow**: Through &#96;handle_conversation_tree&#96; function\n\n### 3. Dispatch Mechanism\n- F8 actions are dispatched via table at Ghidra 0x47E58\n- Table format: 6 bytes per entry (action_id:2, handler_ptr:4)\n- Handler 271 entry: action=271, handler=0x11221\n\n### 4. Handler 271 Behavior\n\nThe handler sets multiple values in room_sprite_data structure:\n\n| Offset | Value | Interpretation |\n|--------|-------|----------------|\n| 0x0BC  | 174 (0xAE) | Unknown state |\n| 0x0BE  | 93 (0x5D) | Unknown |\n| 0x0BF  | 71 (0x47) | Unknown |\n| 0x0C0  | 6603 (0x19CB) | Possibly packed coordinates |\n| 0x0C2  | 2 | Animation sequence? |\n| 0x0C3  | 0 | Flag |\n| 0x0C4  | 1 | Flag |\n| 0x0C5  | 2 | Frame count? |\n| 0x0C8  | 10 | Delay/timing |\n| 0x0C9  | 3 | Unknown |\n| 0x0CC  | 3 | Unknown |\n| 0x0CD  | 2 | Unknown |\n| 0x0D0  | 0 | Flag |\n| 0x0D1  | 10 | Timing |\n| 0x0DD  | 0 | Flag |\n| 0x0DE  | 0 | Flag |\n| 0x0E6  | 241 (0xF1) | X coordinate |\n| 0x0E8  | 334 (0x14E) | Y coordinate |\n| 0x0EA  | 55 (0x37) | Width? |\n| 0x0EB  | 66 (0x42) | Height? |\n| 0x0EC  | 3630 (0x0E2E) | Sprite offset/stride? |\n| 0x0EE  | 1 | Enable flag |\n| 0x0EF  | 0 | Flag |\n| 0x0F0  | 2 | Animation type |\n| 0x0F8  | 3 | Frame timing |\n| 0x0FC  | 0 | Flag |\n| 0x0FD  | 10 | Timing |\n| 0x109  | 0 | Flag |\n| 0x10A  | 0 | Flag |\n\nThe handler also calls:\n- &#96;wait_or_process_input&#96; (0x2A258) with parameter 0x6A (106 frames = ~5.8 seconds at 18.2Hz)\n- &#96;process_game_state&#96; (0x1BFBA)\n\n### 5. Animation Processing\n\nThe sprite animation is processed by &#96;update_npc_sprite_animations&#96; (0x1628D) which:\n1. Reads sprite count from room_sprite_data+0x05\n2. For each sprite, reads animation data at sprite_index × 0x2C offset\n3. Updates sprite positions based on movement flags\n4. Renders sprites via &#96;render_sprite&#96; or &#96;render_alfred_sprite_scaled&#96;\n\n### 6. Flight Path Visualization\n\nThe dotted/dashed flight path is NOT drawn using &#96;draw_line&#96; or &#96;draw_pixel&#96; functions.\nInstead, it appears to be:\n1. A pre-rendered sprite/animation stored in game data\n2. Displayed progressively frame-by-frame as a sprite animation\n3. Coordinates (241, 334) suggest it appears in the middle-lower portion of the screen\n\n### 7. Room 45 (Egypt)\n\nRoom 45 (0x2D) is the Egypt destination room. Key facts:\n- Has special handling in &#96;render_sprite&#96; for shadow/reflection effects\n- No per-frame handler in dispatch table at 0x485BC\n- No room init handler in dispatch table at 0x484E4\n\n## Related Code Locations\n\n| Function | Address | Purpose |\n|----------|---------|---------|\n| handle_conversation_tree | 0x186AA | Dispatches F8 actions |\n| update_npc_sprite_animations | 0x1628D | Processes sprite animations |\n| render_sprite | 0x16D10 | Renders sprites (special room 45 handling) |\n| wait_or_process_input | 0x2A258 | Wait with input processing |\n| process_game_state | 0x1BFBA | Game state machine |\n\n## Dispatch Tables\n\n| Table | Address | Purpose |\n|-------|---------|---------|\n| F8 Action Dispatch | 0x47E58 | Maps F8 action IDs to handlers |\n| Per-Frame Room Handlers | 0x485BC | Per-frame room-specific code |\n| Room Init Handlers | 0x484E4 | Room initialization handlers |\n| Per-Render Room Handlers | 0x48630 | Per-render room-specific code |\n\n## Files Generated\n\n- &#96;handler271_disasm.txt&#96; - Disassembled handler 271 code\n- &#96;action271_results.txt&#96; - F8 action 271 search results\n- &#96;room9_analysis.txt&#96; - Room 9 text data analysis\n- &#96;render_dispatch.txt&#96; - Per-render dispatch table dump\n",

}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Disassemble the room 9 per-render handler at 0x1167A.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef disassemble_x86(data, base_addr):\n    \"\"\"Basic x86 disassembly.\"\"\"\n    pos = 0\n    lines = []\n    \n    while pos &lt; len(data) and pos &lt; 300:\n        addr = base_addr + pos\n        \n        # Get opcode\n        op = data[pos]\n        \n        # Common patterns\n        if op == 0xA1:  # MOV EAX, [imm32]\n            if pos + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n                lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: mov eax, [0x{imm:05X}]')\n                pos += 5\n                continue\n                \n        elif op == 0x8B:  # MOV r32, r/m32\n            if pos + 1 &lt;= len(data):\n                modrm = data[pos+1]\n                if modrm == 0x1D and pos + 6 &lt;= len(data):  # MOV EBX, [imm32]\n                    imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n                    lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: mov ebx, [0x{imm:05X}]')\n                    pos += 6\n                    continue\n                elif modrm == 0x0D and pos + 6 &lt;= len(data):  # MOV ECX, [imm32]\n                    imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n                    lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: mov ecx, [0x{imm:05X}]')\n                    pos += 6\n                    continue\n                    \n        elif op == 0xE8:  # CALL rel32\n            if pos + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', data[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n                target = addr + 5 + rel\n                lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: call 0x{target:05X}')\n                pos += 5\n                continue\n                \n        elif op == 0xC3:  # RET\n            lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: ret')\n            pos += 1\n            break\n            \n        elif op == 0xE9:  # JMP rel32\n            if pos + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', data[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n                target = addr + 5 + rel\n                lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: jmp 0x{target:05X}')\n                pos += 5\n                continue\n                \n        elif op == 0x0F:  # Two-byte opcode\n            if pos + 1 &lt; len(data):\n                op2 = data[pos+1]\n                if op2 == 0xB6:  # MOVZX\n                    lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: movzx ...')\n                    pos += 3  # Simplified\n                    continue\n                    \n        elif op == 0x83:  # CMP/ADD r/m32, imm8\n            if pos + 3 &lt;= len(data):\n                modrm = data[pos+1]\n                imm = data[pos+2]\n                if modrm == 0xF8:\n                    lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: cmp eax, {imm}')\n                elif modrm == 0xC4:\n                    lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: add esp, {imm}')\n                pos += 3\n                continue\n                \n        elif op == 0x31:  # XOR r32, r32\n            if pos + 2 &lt;= len(data):\n                modrm = data[pos+1]\n                if modrm == 0xC0:\n                    lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: xor eax, eax')\n                elif modrm == 0xC9:\n                    lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: xor ecx, ecx')\n                pos += 2\n                continue\n                \n        elif op == 0x68:  # PUSH imm32\n            if pos + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n                lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: push 0x{imm:X}')\n                pos += 5\n                continue\n                \n        elif op == 0x6A:  # PUSH imm8\n            if pos + 2 &lt;= len(data):\n                imm = data[pos+1]\n                lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: push {imm}')\n                pos += 2\n                continue\n                \n        elif op == 0x74 or op == 0x75:  # JZ/JNZ rel8\n            if pos + 2 &lt;= len(data):\n                rel = struct.unpack('&lt;b', data[pos+1:pos+2])[0]\n                target = addr + 2 + rel\n                jmp_type = 'jz' if op == 0x74 else 'jnz'\n                lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: {jmp_type} 0x{target:05X}')\n                pos += 2\n                continue\n                \n        elif op == 0xC6:  # MOV r/m8, imm8\n            if pos + 1 &lt; len(data) and data[pos+1] == 0x05:  # MOV [imm32], imm8\n                if pos + 7 &lt;= len(data):\n                    imm_addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n                    imm_val = data[pos+6]\n                    lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: mov byte [0x{imm_addr:05X}], {imm_val}')\n                    pos += 7\n                    continue\n        \n        # Default: show raw bytes\n        end = min(pos + 6, len(data))\n        raw = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in data[pos:end])\n        lines.append(f'  0x{addr:05X}: db {raw}')\n        pos += 1\n    \n    return lines\n\n\n# Read and disassemble room 9 per-render handler\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    # Handler at 0x1167A\n    # Code segment: ghidra = file_offset - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n    # So: file_offset = ghidra - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n    ghidra_addr = 0x1167A\n    file_offset = ghidra_addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n    \n    f.seek(file_offset)\n    data = f.read(400)\n    \n    print('Room 9 Per-Render Handler Analysis')\n    print('=' * 60)\n    print(f'Ghidra address: 0x{ghidra_addr:05X}')\n    print(f'File offset: 0x{file_offset:X}')\n    print()\n    print('Raw bytes:')\n    for i in range(0, min(100, len(data)), 16):\n        hex_bytes = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in data[i:i+16])\n        print(f'  0x{ghidra_addr + i:05X}: {hex_bytes}')\n    print()\n    print('Disassembly:')\n    print('-' * 60)\n    \n    lines = disassemble_x86(data, ghidra_addr)\n    for line in lines:\n        print(line)\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Search for Egypt travel animation code.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nprint(\"=== Search for CD track 26 (0x1A) ===\")\n# push 0x1A (short form)\ntarget = bytes([0x6A, 0x1A])\npos = 0\ncount = 0\nwhile count &lt; 50:\n    pos = data.find(target, pos)\n    if pos == -1:\n        break\n    if pos &lt; 0x3E096:  # In code segment\n        mem_addr = 0x10000 + (pos - 0x1000) if pos &gt;= 0x1000 else pos\n        context = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in data[max(0,pos-4):pos+8])\n        print(f'  File 0x{pos:05X} -&gt; mem 0x{mem_addr:05X}: {context}')\n    pos += 1\n    count += 1\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== Searching for room 21 (0x15) destination ===\")\n# Look for mov [something], 0x15 or similar for setting next room to 21\ntarget = bytes([0x15, 0x00])  # Room 21 as word\npos = 0\nmatches = []\nwhile len(matches) &lt; 20:\n    pos = data.find(target, pos)\n    if pos == -1:\n        break\n    if 0x1000 &lt;= pos &lt; 0x3E096:  # In code segment\n        mem_addr = 0x10000 + (pos - 0x1000)\n        # Check if this looks like code (not random data)\n        prev_bytes = data[max(0,pos-2):pos]\n        if prev_bytes:\n            # Check for common x86 patterns\n            if prev_bytes[-1] in [0xB8, 0xB9, 0xBA, 0xBB, 0xBC, 0xBD, 0xBE, 0xBF, 0x66]:\n                matches.append((pos, mem_addr))\n    pos += 1\n\nfor pos, mem_addr in matches[:10]:\n    context = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in data[max(0,pos-6):pos+6])\n    print(f'  File 0x{pos:05X} -&gt; mem 0x{mem_addr:05X}: {context}')\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== Checking dispatch table for trigger 279 ===\")\n# Trigger 279 = 0x117\ntrigger_bytes = struct.pack('&lt;H', 279)\nprint(f\"Trigger 279 bytes: {trigger_bytes.hex()}\")\n\npos = 0\nwhile True:\n    pos = data.find(trigger_bytes, pos)\n    if pos == -1:\n        break\n    if 0x3E096 &lt;= pos &lt; len(data):  # In data segment\n        mem_addr = 0x40000 + (pos - 0x3E096)\n        context = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in data[pos:pos+6])\n        func_addr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, pos+2)[0] if pos + 6 &lt;= len(data) else 0\n        print(f'  File 0x{pos:05X} -&gt; mem 0x{mem_addr:05X}: {context}')\n        print(f'    Handler function: 0x{func_addr:05X}')\n    pos += 1\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== Finding function at 0x11449 ===\")\n# The code at 0x11449 - calculate file offset\n# Memory address 0x11449 maps to file offset\n# Code segment: .object1 00010000 - 0003e096\n# So file offset = 0x11449 - 0x10000 + code_section_raw_offset\n# Looking at typical LE EXE, raw offset is around 0x1000\n\n# Let's verify by looking for a known function\nknown_func = 0x10442  # main_game_loop from the function list\nfile_off = known_func - 0x10000 + 0x1000\nprint(f\"main_game_loop at 0x10442 should be at file offset 0x{file_off:X}\")\nprint(f\"Bytes there: {' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in data[file_off:file_off+16])}\")\n\nfunc_addr = 0x11449\nfile_off = func_addr - 0x10000 + 0x1000\nprint(f\"\\nHandler 0x11449 should be at file offset 0x{file_off:X}\")\nprint(f\"Bytes there: {' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in data[file_off:file_off+32])}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze the LE executable format to find correct offsets.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Check MZ header\nprint(\"=== MZ Header ===\")\nmagic = data[0:2]\nprint(f\"Magic: {magic}\")\n\n# Get offset to LE header\ne_lfanew = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, 0x3C)[0]\nprint(f\"e_lfanew (offset to new header): 0x{e_lfanew:X}\")\n\n# Check what's at that offset\nle_magic = data[e_lfanew:e_lfanew+2]\nprint(f\"Header magic at 0x{e_lfanew:X}: {le_magic}\")\n\nif le_magic == b'LE':\n    print(\"\\nThis is an LE (Linear Executable) format!\")\n    \n    # LE header structure\n    # Offset 0x00: Signature 'LE'\n    # Offset 0x10: Initial EIP  \n    # Offset 0x14: Initial ESP\n    # Offset 0x40: Object Table Offset (from LE header start)\n    # Offset 0x44: Number of objects\n    # Offset 0x80: Data pages offset (from file start)\n    \n    obj_table_off = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, e_lfanew + 0x40)[0]\n    num_objects = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, e_lfanew + 0x44)[0]\n    data_pages_off = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, e_lfanew + 0x80)[0]\n    \n    print(f\"\\nObject Table offset: 0x{obj_table_off:X} (from LE header)\")\n    print(f\"Number of objects: {num_objects}\")\n    print(f\"Data pages offset: 0x{data_pages_off:X}\")\n    \n    # Parse object table\n    obj_table_start = e_lfanew + obj_table_off\n    print(f\"\\nObject table at file offset 0x{obj_table_start:X}\")\n    \n    # Each object entry is 24 bytes\n    for i in range(min(num_objects, 10)):\n        entry_off = obj_table_start + i * 24\n        virtual_size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, entry_off)[0]\n        base_addr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, entry_off + 4)[0]\n        flags = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, entry_off + 8)[0]\n        page_table_idx = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, entry_off + 12)[0]\n        num_pages = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, entry_off + 16)[0]\n        \n        print(f\"\\n  Object {i+1}:\")\n        print(f\"    Virtual Size: 0x{virtual_size:X}\")\n        print(f\"    Base Address: 0x{base_addr:X}\")\n        print(f\"    Flags: 0x{flags:X}\")\n        print(f\"    Page Table Index: {page_table_idx}\")\n        print(f\"    Num Pages: {num_pages}\")\n\n# Now let's find where function 0x11449 really is\n# In Ghidra, .object1 is at 00010000 - 0003e096\n# So if 0x11449 is in .object1, we need to find the file offset for that object\n\nprint(\"\\n=== Searching for known code patterns ===\")\n\n# Look for a recognizable function prologue near 0x11449\n# Common patterns: 55 8B EC (push ebp; mov ebp, esp)\n# Or 53 (push ebx), 56 (push esi), etc.\n\n# Let's search for the function that Ghidra knows: game_initialization at 0x10010\n# This should help us find the mapping\n\n# Search for a distinctive byte sequence that would be at 0x10010\nprint(\"\\nLooking for game_initialization (0x10010)...\")\n\n# From the file, let's just scan for reasonable file offsets\n# The code should start after the LE header and page tables\n\n# Find the start of actual code\nfor offset in range(0x1000, min(len(data), 0x5000), 0x100):\n    chunk = data[offset:offset+4]\n    # Look for function prologue patterns\n    if chunk[:2] == b'\\x55\\x8B':  # push ebp; mov ebp,...\n        print(f\"  Possible function at file offset 0x{offset:X}\")\n        print(f\"    Bytes: {' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in data[offset:offset+16])}\")\n        break\n",

call 0x{target:05X}')\n\nprint()\nprint('Looking for the function that uses both CD track 26 and room 21...')\n\n# The CD track 26 push was at file 0x28BCC\n# Let's look around that area for room 21 references\nstart = 0x28B00\nend = 0x28E00\n\nfor i in range(start, end):\n    if data[i:i+2] == bytes([0x6A, 0x15]):  # push 0x15\n        code_va = 0x10000 + (i - 0x14200)\n        print(f'  push 0x15 at VA 0x{code_va:05X} (file 0x{i:05X})')\n    if data[i:i+4] == bytes([0x15, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00]):\n        code_va = 0x10000 + (i - 0x14200)\n        prev = data[i-2:i]\n        print(f'  imm32 0x15 at VA 0x{code_va:05X}, prev bytes: {prev.hex()}')\n",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Dump bytes around room 21 assignments to understand context.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# The three locations:\n# VA 0x100E8: mov word [0x18568], 0x15\n# VA 0x10C24: mov word [0x0FB70], 0x15\n# VA 0x10C96: mov word [0x0FB78], 0x15\n\nlocations = [\n    (0x100E8, 'mov word [0x18568], 0x15'),\n    (0x10C24, 'mov word [0x0FB70], 0x15'),\n    (0x10C96, 'mov word [0x0FB78], 0x15'),\n]\n\nfor va, desc in locations:\n    file_off = va - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n    print(f'\\n=== VA 0x{va:05X} (file 0x{file_off:05X}) ===')\n    print(f'Instruction: {desc}')\n    \n    # Read 64 bytes before and 32 bytes after\n    start = file_off - 64\n    end = file_off + 32\n    chunk = data[start:end]\n    \n    print(f'\\nContext bytes (file 0x{start:05X} - 0x{end:05X}):')\n    for i in range(0, len(chunk), 16):\n        addr = start + i\n        va_addr = 0x10000 + (addr - 0x14200)\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in chunk[i:i+16])\n        ascii_str = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else '.' for b in chunk[i:i+16])\n        marker = ' &lt;&lt;&lt; TARGET' if start + i &lt;= file_off &lt; start + i + 16 else ''\n        print(f'  {va_addr:05X}: {hex_str}  {ascii_str}{marker}')\n\n# Now let's also look at the trigger 279 handler at 0x11449\nprint('\\n\\n=== Handler 0x11449 for trigger 279 ===')\nva = 0x11449\nfile_off = va - 0x10000 + 0x14200\nstart = file_off\nend = file_off + 256\n\nchunk = data[start:end]\nprint(f'Bytes at VA 0x{va:05X}:')\nfor i in range(0, len(chunk), 16):\n    addr = start + i\n    va_addr = 0x10000 + (addr - 0x14200)\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in chunk[i:i+16])\n    print(f'  {va_addr:05X}: {hex_str}')\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/analyze_egypt_anim.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/analyze_egypt_anim.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Find the function that displays Egypt animation by tracing CD track 26.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# CD track 26 was found at file offsets 0x28BCC and 0x28C46\n# Let's find function start by looking for common prologue patterns\n\n# Search backwards from 0x28BCC to find function start\ndef find_function_start(file_offset):\n    \"\"\"Try to find function start by looking for prologue patterns.\"\"\"\n    # Common prologues: push ebp; mov ebp, esp OR push ebx/esi/edi patterns\n    for i in range(file_offset, max(file_offset - 0x500, 0x14200), -1):\n        # Check for push ebp (0x55)\n        if data[i] == 0x55 and data[i+1] == 0x89 and data[i+2] == 0xE5:\n            return i\n        # Check for alignment/padding (series of 0x90 or 0xCC before function)\n        if i &gt; 1 and data[i-1] in (0x90, 0xCC, 0xC3) and data[i] not in (0x90, 0xCC, 0xC3):\n            # Could be function start\n            va = 0x10000 + (i - 0x14200)\n            if va % 16 == 0:  # Functions often 16-byte aligned\n                return i\n    return None\n\nprint('Analyzing CD track 26 area...')\nprint()\n\n# File offset 0x28BCC = VA 0x249CC\n# File offset 0x28C46 = VA 0x24A46\n\nfor name, file_off in [('First push 0x1A', 0x28BCC), ('Second push 0x1A', 0x28C46)]:\n    va = 0x10000 + (file_off - 0x14200)\n    print(f'{name} at file 0x{file_off:05X} = VA 0x{va:05X}')\n\n    # Read context\n    start = file_off - 48\n    end = file_off + 48\n    chunk = data[start:end]\n    \n    print(f'Context:')\n    for i in range(0, len(chunk), 16):\n        addr = start + i\n        va_addr = 0x10000 + (addr - 0x14200)\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in chunk[i:i+16])\n        marker = ' &lt;&lt;&lt; CD TRACK' if start + i &lt;= file_off &lt; start + i + 16 else ''\n        print(f'  {va_addr:05X}: {hex_str}{marker}')\n    print()\n\n# Let's also search for loading the Egypt screen offset (0xB11F1)\nprint('Searching for Egypt screen offset references...')\n\n# Look for the bytes F1 11 0B 00 (little-endian 0x000B11F1)\ntarget = bytes([0xF1, 0x11, 0x0B, 0x00])\nfor i in range(0x14200, 0x43200 - 4):\n    if data[i:i+4] == target:\n        va = 0x10000 + (i - 0x14200)\n        prev_bytes = data[max(0,i-10):i]\n        print(f'  Found at file 0x{i:05X} = VA 0x{va:05X}')\n        print(f'    Previous bytes: {prev_bytes.hex()}')\n\n# Also check data segment (file 0x43200+)\nprint()\nprint('In data segment:')\nfor i in range(0x43200, len(data) - 4):\n    if data[i:i+4] == target:\n        va = 0x40000 + (i - 0x43200)\n        prev_bytes = data[max(0,i-10):i]\n        print(f'  Found at file 0x{i:05X} = data VA 0x{va:05X}')\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

mov ebp,esp) at VA 0x{va:05X}')\n\nprint()\nprint('=== Key locations ===')\n\n# CD track 26 locations\nfor offset_name, file_off in [\n    ('First push 0x1A', 0x28BCC),\n    ('Second push 0x1A', 0x28C46),\n    ('Jmp target 0x24A5E', 0x14200 + (0x24A5E - 0x10000)),\n    ('Jmp target 0x249A4', 0x14200 + (0x249A4 - 0x10000)),\n]:\n    va = 0x10000 + (file_off - 0x14200)\n    chunk = data[file_off:file_off+32]\n    print(f'\\n{offset_name} at VA 0x{va:05X}:')\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in chunk)\n    print(f'  {hex_str}')\n\n# Now let's analyze the trigger 279 dispatch more carefully\n# From ACTION_DISPATCH_TABLES.md, trigger 279 goes to handler 0x11449\n# But that seems to be a different function\n\n# Let's find what actually sets room = 21 by looking at the room destination variable\n# From the earlier search: 0x0FB70 stores the destination room\n\nprint()\nprint('=== Looking for uses of destination room variable 0x0FB70 ===')\n\ntarget_bytes = struct.pack('&lt;I', 0x0FB70)\nfor i in range(0x14200, 0x43200 - 6):\n    if data[i:i+4] == target_bytes:\n        code_va = 0x10000 + (i - 0x14200)\n        context = data[i-6:i+10]\n        print(f'  VA 0x{code_va:05X}: {context.hex()}')\n",

0xDEE9 = 0x16B01\n\nfile_off = 0x14200 + (0x249CC - 0x10000)\nchunk = data[file_off:file_off+32]\nprint('First CD track 26 location (VA 0x249CC):')\nprint(f'  Bytes: {chunk.hex()}')\n\n# Find the call instruction\nfor i in range(len(chunk) - 0x10000)\nchunk = data[file_off:file_off+32]\nprint('Second CD track 26 location (VA 0x24A46):')\nprint(f'  Bytes: {chunk.hex()}')\n\nfor i in range(len(chunk) - 5):\n    if chunk[i] == 0xE8:\n        rel = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', chunk, i+1)[0]\n        call_va = 0x24A46 + i\n        target = call_va + 5 + rel\n        print(f'  Call at +{i} (VA 0x{call_va:05X}): call 0x{target:05X}')\n\nprint()\nprint('Looking for what function 0x16B01 is...')\n# Actually it should be 0x16B00 -   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Find which play_cd_audio_track calls use track 26.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# All calls to play_cd_audio_track\ncd_calls = [\n    0x10DD3, 0x10FE2, 0x15D15, 0x1B978, 0x207A2, 0x20CA7,\n    0x2320E, 0x247DC, 0x24980, 0x24BE3, 0x24CDA, 0x24E3B\n]\n\nprint('=== Checking which play_cd_audio_track calls use track 26 ===')\nprint()\n\nfor call_va in cd_calls:\n    file_off = 0x14200 + (call_va - 0x10000)\n    \n    # Read bytes before the call to find the track parameter\n    # The track is typically pushed before the call\n    before = data[file_off - 20:file_off]\n    \n    # Look for push imm8 (6A xx) or push imm32 (68 xx xx xx xx) \n    track = None\n    for i in range(len(before) - 1, -1, -1):\n        if before[i] == 0x6A:  # push imm8\n            track = before[i+1]\n            break\n        elif before[i] == 0x68:  # push imm32\n            if i + 4 &lt; len(before):\n                track = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', before, i+1)[0]\n            break\n    \n    # Get a larger context\n    context = data[file_off - 32:file_off + 5]\n    \n    if track == 0x1A:\n        print(f'*** VA 0x{call_va:05X}: Track 26! ***')\n        print(f'    Context before call: {context[:32].hex()}')\n    else:\n        print(f'VA 0x{call_va:05X}: Track {track if track else \"unknown\"}')\n\nprint()\nprint('=== Now checking context of 0x24980 (likely Egypt track 26) ===')\n\n# 0x24980 is in the same area as the Egypt animation\nva = 0x24980\nfile_off = 0x14200 + (va - 0x10000)\ncontext = data[file_off - 48:file_off + 16]\nprint(f'Context around call at VA 0x{va:05X}:')\nfor i in range(0, len(context), 16):\n    addr = va - 48 + i\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in context[i:i+16])\n    marker = ' &lt;&lt;&lt; CALL' if 48 &lt;= i &lt; 64 else ''\n    print(f'  {addr:05X}: {hex_str}{marker}')\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

## Egypt Travel Animation Summary

### Animation Mechanism
The Egypt travel animation is **NOT** drawn using line-drawing code. Instead, it uses a **pre-rendered sprite animation**:

1. **Trigger**: F8 action 271 (from Room 9 conversation, not Room 20)
2. **Handler**: 0x11221

| Sprite | Size | Position | Purpose |
|--------|------|----------|---------|
| Sprite 4 | 93×71 px | Y=174 | Larger animation element |
| Sprite 5 | 55×66 px | (241, 334) | Likely the plane indicator |
| Sprite 6 | (configured) | | Additional element |

The "discontinuous line segments" you described are actually **frames of a pre-rendered sprite animation** stored in the game data files, not dynamically drawn lines. The animation appears frame-by-frame as the sprite system cycles through its configured frames.

### Key Points
- The flight path is a sprite-based animation, not line drawing
- The extra screen (map) at ALFRED.7 offset 0xB11F1 is displayed as the background
- Sprite animation timing: ~3 ticks per frame, running for ~5.8 seconds (106 frames at 18.2 Hz)
- Animation is processed by `update_npc_sprite_animations` (0x1628D)

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/find_room20_handler.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/find_room20_handler.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nFind the room 20 (travel agency) handler that triggers the Egypt animation.\nThe per-room handler dispatch table is at VA 0x485BC.\nEach entry is: room_number:2, function_ptr:4 (6 bytes)\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\n# File offsets\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\ndef va_to_file(va):\n    if va &gt;= DATA_VA_BASE:\n        return va - DATA_VA_BASE + DATA_FILE_BASE\n    elif va &gt;= CODE_VA_BASE:\n        return va - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\n    return va\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    # Read the per-room handler dispatch table at VA 0x485BC\n    table_va = 0x485BC\n    table_file = va_to_file(table_va)\n    \n    print(f\"Per-room handler dispatch table at VA 0x{table_va:05X}, file offset 0x{table_file:05X}\")\n    print()\n    \n    f.seek(table_file)\n    \n    # Read entries until we find -1 (0xFFFF) terminator\n    entry_num = 0\n    found_room20 = False\n    \n    while True:\n        data = f.read(6)\n        if len(data) &lt; 6:\n            break\n        \n        room_num, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HI', data)\n        \n        if room_num == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"[End of table at entry {entry_num}]\")\n            break\n        \n        print(f\"Entry {entry_num}: Room {room_num:2d} (0x{room_num:02X}) -&gt; Handler at VA 0x{func_ptr:05X}\")\n        \n        if room_num == 20:\n            found_room20 = True\n            print(f\"   *** ROOM 20 (Travel Agency) HANDLER FOUND! ***\")\n            print(f\"   Handler function at VA 0x{func_ptr:05X}, file offset 0x{va_to_file(func_ptr):05X}\")\n        \n        entry_num += 1\n        if entry_num &gt; 100:  # Safety limit\n            print(\"[Stopping after 100 entries]\")\n            break\n    \n    # Now let's also search for where the Egypt offset 0x0B11F1 is loaded\n    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n    print(\"Searching for Egypt screen offset 0x0B11F1 usage in code...\")\n    \n    f.seek(CODE_FILE_BASE)\n    code_data = f.read(0x30000)  # Read code segment\n    \n    # Search for the push or mov of 0x0B11F1\n    patterns = [\n        (b'\\xF1\\x11\\x0B\\x00', \"0x000B11F1 (little-endian dword)\"),\n        (b'\\xF1\\x11\\x0B', \"0x0B11F1 (3-byte)\"),\n    ]\n    \n    for pattern, desc in patterns:\n        pos = 0\n        while True:\n            pos = code_data.find(pattern, pos)\n            if pos == -1:\n                break\n            va = CODE_VA_BASE + pos\n            print(f\"Found {desc} at code VA 0x{va:05X}, file offset 0x{CODE_FILE_BASE + pos:05X}\")\n            pos += 1\n    \n    # Search in data segment too\n    f.seek(DATA_FILE_BASE)\n    data_data = f.read(0x20000)  # Read data segment\n    \n    for pattern, desc in patterns:\n        pos = 0\n        while True:\n            pos = data_data.find(pattern, pos)\n            if pos == -1:\n                break\n            va = DATA_VA_BASE + pos\n            print(f\"Found {desc} at data VA 0x{va:05X}, file offset 0x{DATA_FILE_BASE + pos:05X}\")\n            pos += 1\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
```

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSearch for code that sets room to 21 (Egypt destination).\nLook for:\n- mov word [0xFB70], 0x15  (set room_to_go_to = 21)\n- Also find code that loads/references the Egypt screen table entry at 0x48A00\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\n# File offsets\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\ndef va_to_file(va):\n    if va &gt;= DATA_VA_BASE:\n        return va - DATA_VA_BASE + DATA_FILE_BASE\n    elif va &gt;= CODE_VA_BASE:\n        return va - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\n    return va\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(CODE_FILE_BASE)\n    code_data = f.read(0x30000)  # Read code segment\n    \n    # Pattern 1: mov word ptr [0x4FB70], 0x15\n    # The address 0xFB70 in code is probably relative - let me check both forms\n    # In flat model it would be [0x4FB70] \n    # Encoding: 66 C7 05 &lt;addr32&gt; &lt;imm16&gt;\n    \n    # Pattern: Set current_room_number to 21 (0x15)\n    # Try various encodings\n    patterns = [\n        # mov word ptr [addr], 0x15\n        (b'\\x66\\xC7\\x05\\x70\\xFB\\x04\\x00\\x15\\x00', \"mov word [0x4FB70], 0x15\"),\n        # Just look for 0x15 0x00 preceded by address 0x4FB70\n        (b'\\x70\\xFB\\x04\\x00\\x15\\x00', \"ref to 0x4FB70 followed by 0x15\"),\n    ]\n    \n    print(\"Searching for 'set room to 21' patterns...\")\n    for pattern, desc in patterns:\n        pos = 0\n        while True:\n            pos = code_data.find(pattern, pos)\n            if pos == -1:\n                break\n            va = CODE_VA_BASE + pos\n            # Show context\n            context = code_data[max(0,pos-8):pos+len(pattern)+8]\n            print(f\"Found '{desc}' at VA 0x{va:05X}\")\n            print(f\"  Context: {context.hex()}\")\n            pos += 1\n    \n    # Pattern 2: Search for any reference to 0x4FB70\n    print(\"\\nSearching for references to 0x4FB70...\")\n    pattern = b'\\x70\\xFB\\x04\\x00'\n    pos = 0\n    count = 0\n    while True:\n        pos = code_data.find(pattern, pos)\n        if pos == -1:\n            break\n        va = CODE_VA_BASE + pos\n        # Check what follows\n        next_bytes = code_data[pos+4:pos+8]\n        if len(next_bytes) &gt;= 2:\n            imm = struct.unpack('&lt;H', next_bytes[:2])[0]\n            if imm == 21 or imm == 20:  # Room 20 or 21\n                print(f\"  VA 0x{va:05X}: ref to 0x4FB70, next imm16 = {imm} (room!)\")\n                # Show more context\n                context = code_data[max(0,pos-16):pos+16]\n                print(f\"    Context: {context.hex()}\")\n        count += 1\n        pos += 1\n    print(f\"  Total references to 0x4FB70: {count}\")\n    \n    # Pattern 3: Search for Egypt screen table entry reference (0x48A00)\n    print(\"\\nSearching for references to Egypt table entry at 0x48A00...\")\n    pattern = b'\\x00\\x8A\\x04\\x00'  # Little-endian 0x00048A00\n    pos = 0\n    while True:\n        pos = code_data.find(pattern, pos)\n        if pos == -1:\n            break\n        va = CODE_VA_BASE + pos\n        context = code_data[max(0,pos-8):pos+12]\n        print(f\"Found ref to 0x48A00 at VA 0x{va:05X}\")\n        print(f\"  Context: {context.hex()}\")\n        pos += 1\n    \n    # Search in nearby addresses too\n    for offset in [0x48980, 0x48990, 0x489A0, 0x489F0, 0x48A30]:\n        pattern = struct.pack('&lt;I', offset)\n        pos = code_data.find(pattern)\n        if pos != -1:\n            va = CODE_VA_BASE + pos\n            print(f\"Found ref to 0x{offset:05X} at VA 0x{va:05X}\")\n    \n    # Pattern 4: Search for CD track 26 (0x1A) push before call\n    print(\"\\nSearching for push 0x1A (track 26) patterns...\")\n    # push 0x1A could be: 6A 1A (push imm8) or 68 1A 00 00 00 (push imm32)\n    patterns = [\n        (b'\\x6A\\x1A', \"push 0x1A (imm8)\"),\n        (b'\\x68\\x1A\\x00\\x00\\x00', \"push 0x1A (imm32)\"),\n    ]\n    for pattern, desc in patterns:\n        pos = 0\n        while True:\n            pos = code_data.find(pattern, pos)\n            if pos == -1:\n                break\n            va = CODE_VA_BASE + pos\n            # Check if followed by a call\n            rest = code_data[pos+len(pattern):pos+len(pattern)+10]\n            if rest and (rest[0] == 0xE8 or (rest[0] == 0xFF and len(rest) &gt; 1)):\n                print(f\"  VA 0x{va:05X}: {desc} followed by call at +{len(pattern)}\")\n                context = code_data[pos:pos+20]\n                print(f\"    Bytes: {context.hex()}\")\n            pos += 1\n    \n    # Search for the specific Egypt offset 0x0B11F1 in code (push or mov)\n    print(\"\\nSearching for 0x0B11F1 usage in code (push/mov)...\")\n    # 68 F1 11 0B 00 = push 0x0B11F1\n    patterns = [\n        (b'\\x68\\xF1\\x11\\x0B\\x00', \"push 0x0B11F1\"),\n        (b'\\xB8\\xF1\\x11\\x0B\\x00', \"mov eax, 0x0B11F1\"),\n    ]\n    for pattern, desc in patterns:\n        pos = code_data.find(pattern)\n        if pos != -1:\n            va = CODE_VA_BASE + pos\n            print(f\"  Found '{desc}' at VA 0x{va:05X}\")\n",

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/extract_all_dispatch_tables.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/extract_all_dispatch_tables.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract ALL hotspot dispatch tables:\n- 0x47BF0 (dispatch_hotspot_action_by_extra_id)\n- 0x47C10 (execute_script_table_0x47c10)\n- 0x47C18 (execute_script_table_0x47c18)\n- 0x47CBC (execute_script_table_0x47cbc)\n\nEach table: 6-byte entries [2-byte extra_id, 4-byte function_ptr]\nFind any handler in the 0x10900-0x10D00 range or with Egypt-related IDs.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\ndef va_to_file(va):\n    if va &gt;= DATA_VA_BASE:\n        return va - DATA_VA_BASE + DATA_FILE_BASE\n    elif va &gt;= CODE_VA_BASE:\n        return va - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\n    return va\n\ndef extract_table(f, table_va, table_name):\n    table_file = va_to_file(table_va)\n    f.seek(table_file)\n    \n    print(f\"\\n{'='*70}\")\n    print(f\"{table_name} at VA 0x{table_va:05X}\")\n    print(f\"{'='*70}\")\n    \n    entries = []\n    entry_num = 0\n    \n    while True:\n        data = f.read(6)\n        if len(data) &lt; 6:\n            break\n        \n        extra_id, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HI', data)\n        \n        if extra_id == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"  [End of table at entry {entry_num}]\")\n            break\n        \n        entries.append((extra_id, func_ptr))\n        \n        marker = \"\"\n        if 0x10900 &lt;= func_ptr &lt;= 0x10D00:\n            marker = \" *** IN EGYPT CODE RANGE! ***\"\n        elif 0x10000 &lt;= func_ptr &lt;= 0x11000:\n            marker = \" (in 0x10000-0x11000 range)\"\n        \n        print(f\"  Entry {entry_num:3d}: Extra ID {extra_id:4d} (0x{extra_id:04X}) -&gt; Handler VA 0x{func_ptr:05X}{marker}\")\n        \n        entry_num += 1\n        if entry_num &gt; 300:\n            print(\"  [Stopping after 300 entries]\")\n            break\n    \n    return entries\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    all_entries = []\n    \n    # Main dispatch tables\n    tables = [\n        (0x47BF0, \"dispatch_hotspot_action_by_extra_id\"),\n        (0x47C10, \"execute_script_table_0x47c10\"),\n        (0x47C18, \"execute_script_table_0x47c18\"),\n        (0x47CBC, \"execute_script_table_0x47cbc\"),\n    ]\n    \n    for table_va, table_name in tables:\n        entries = extract_table(f, table_va, table_name)\n        all_entries.extend(entries)\n    \n    # Summary\n    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\n    print(\"SUMMARY: Handlers in interesting code ranges\")\n    print(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    for extra_id, func_ptr in sorted(all_entries, key=lambda x: x[1]):\n        if 0x10000 &lt;= func_ptr &lt;= 0x12000:\n            print(f\"  Extra ID {extra_id:4d} -&gt; Handler VA 0x{func_ptr:05X}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract the complex item script table at 0x48118.\nEach entry is 8 bytes: [2-byte id1, 2-byte id2, 4-byte function_ptr]\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\ndef va_to_file(va):\n    if va &gt;= DATA_VA_BASE:\n        return va - DATA_VA_BASE + DATA_FILE_BASE\n    elif va &gt;= CODE_VA_BASE:\n        return va - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\n    return va\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    table_va = 0x48118\n    table_file = va_to_file(table_va)\n    \n    print(f\"Complex item script table at VA 0x{table_va:05X}\")\n    print(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    f.seek(table_file)\n    \n    entry_num = 0\n    while True:\n        data = f.read(8)\n        if len(data) &lt; 8:\n            break\n        \n        id1, id2, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', data)\n        \n        if id1 == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"\\n[End of table at entry {entry_num}]\")\n            break\n        \n        marker = \"\"\n        if 0x10900 &lt;= func_ptr &lt;= 0x10D00:\n            marker = \" *** IN EGYPT CODE RANGE! ***\"\n        elif 0x10000 &lt;= func_ptr &lt;= 0x11500:\n            marker = \" (in 0x10000-0x11500 range)\"\n        \n        print(f\"Entry {entry_num:3d}: ID1={id1:4d} ID2={id2:4d} -&gt; Handler VA 0x{func_ptr:05X}{marker}\")\n        \n        entry_num += 1\n        if entry_num &gt; 200:\n            print(\"[Stopping after 200 entries]\")\n            break\n    \n    print(f\"\\nTotal entries: {entry_num}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
```
Status: **completed**


</details>
</tool-use>

len(code_data) - 10:\n        # Check for mov word ptr [addr], 0x15\n        # 66 C7 05 XX XX XX XX 15 00\n        if (code_data[pos] == 0x66 and code_data[pos+1] == 0xC7 and \n            code_data[pos+2] == 0x05 and code_data[pos+7] == 0x15 and\n            code_data[pos+8] == 0x00):\n            va = CODE_VA_BASE + pos\n            addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code_data[pos+3:pos+7])[0]\n            print(f\"VA 0x{va:05X}: mov word [0x{addr:05X}], 0x15\")\n            count += 1\n        \n        # Check for mov ax, 0x15; mov [addr], ax\n        # B8 15 00 (mov ax, 15) - but this is mov eax, not ax\n        # 66 B8 15 00 (mov ax, 15)\n        if (code_data[pos] == 0x66 and code_data[pos+1] == 0xB8 and\n            code_data[pos+2] == 0x15 and code_data[pos+3] == 0x00):\n            va = CODE_VA_BASE + pos\n            print(f\"VA 0x{va:05X}: mov ax, 0x15\")\n            count += 1\n        \n        # push 0x15 followed by something\n        if code_data[pos] == 0x6A and code_data[pos+1] == 0x15:\n            va = CODE_VA_BASE + pos\n            next_byte = code_data[pos+2] if pos+2 &lt;   "isConfirmed": {

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze the Egypt travel code at VA 0x10C00-0x10D00.\nThis code contains:\n- file_seek calls at 0x10C08, 0x10C75, 0x10CF1\n- mov word [0xFB70], 0x15 at 0x10C24 (set room to 21)\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\n\ndef va_to_file(va):\n    return va - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\n\n# Simple x86 disassembler for key patterns\ndef analyze_bytes(data, base_va):\n    pos = 0\n    lines = []\n    while pos &lt; len(data):\n        va = base_va + pos\n        byte = data[pos]\n        \n        # ret\n        if byte == 0xC3:\n            lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: C3           ret\")\n            pos += 1\n        # push imm32\n        elif byte == 0x68:\n            if pos + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n                lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: 68 {data[pos+1:pos+5].hex():8s}  push 0x{imm:X}\")\n                pos += 5\n            else:\n                lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: 68 ???       push ???\")\n                pos += 1\n        # push imm8\n        elif byte == 0x6A:\n            imm = data[pos+1]\n            lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: 6A {imm:02X}        push 0x{imm:X}\")\n            pos += 2\n        # call near rel32\n        elif byte == 0xE8:\n            if pos + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', data[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n                target = va + 5 + rel\n                lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: E8 {data[pos+1:pos+5].hex():8s}  call 0x{target:05X}\")\n                pos += 5\n            else:\n                pos += 1\n        # jmp near rel32\n        elif byte == 0xE9:\n            if pos + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', data[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n                target = va + 5 + rel\n                lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: E9 {data[pos+1:pos+5].hex():8s}  jmp 0x{target:05X}\")\n                pos += 5\n            else:\n                pos += 1\n        # mov with word prefix (66)\n        elif byte == 0x66:\n            if pos + 1 &lt; len(data) and data[pos+1] == 0xC7 and pos + 9 &lt;= len(data):\n                modrm = data[pos+2]\n                if modrm == 0x05:  # mov word [imm32], imm16\n                    addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+3:pos+7])[0]\n                    imm = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[pos+7:pos+9])[0]\n                    lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: 66 C7 05 {data[pos+3:pos+9].hex()}  mov word [0x{addr:X}], 0x{imm:X}\")\n                    pos += 9\n                else:\n                    lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: 66 {data[pos+1]:02X} {modrm:02X} ...  (mov word variant)\")\n                    pos += 3\n            else:\n                lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: 66 ...       (word prefix)\")\n                pos += 1\n        # mov eax, imm32\n        elif byte == 0xB8:\n            if pos + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n                lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: B8 {data[pos+1:pos+5].hex():8s}  mov eax, 0x{imm:X}\")\n                pos += 5\n            else:\n                pos += 1\n        # jz/jnz short (74/75)\n        elif byte == 0x74 or byte == 0x75:\n            rel = struct.unpack('&lt;b', bytes([data[pos+1]]))[0]\n            target = va + 2 + rel\n            mnemonic = \"jz\" if byte == 0x74 else \"jnz\"\n            lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: {byte:02X} {data[pos+1]:02X}        {mnemonic} 0x{target:05X}\")\n            pos += 2\n        # Short jump (EB)\n        elif byte == 0xEB:\n            rel = struct.unpack('&lt;b', bytes([data[pos+1]]))[0]\n            target = va + 2 + rel\n            lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: EB {data[pos+1]:02X}        jmp short 0x{target:05X}\")\n            pos += 2\n        # add esp\n        elif byte == 0x83 and pos + 2 &lt; len(data) and data[pos+1] == 0xC4:\n            imm = data[pos+2]\n            lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: 83 C4 {imm:02X}     add esp, 0x{imm:X}\")\n            pos += 3\n        # cmp [addr], imm\n        elif byte == 0x83 and pos + 6 &lt; len(data) and data[pos+1] == 0x3D:\n            addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n            imm = data[pos+6]\n            lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: 83 3D {data[pos+2:pos+7].hex()}  cmp [0x{addr:X}], 0x{imm:X}\")\n            pos += 7\n        else:\n            # Just show the byte\n            lines.append(f\"{va:05X}: {byte:02X}           ???\")\n            pos += 1\n    \n    return lines\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    # Read code from 0x10B00 to 0x10E00 (includes context before and after)\n    start_va = 0x10B00\n    end_va = 0x10E00\n    \n    f.seek(va_to_file(start_va))\n    data = f.read(end_va - start_va)\n    \n    print(f\"Egypt Travel Animation Code Analysis\")\n    print(f\"VA Range: 0x{start_va:05X} - 0x{end_va:05X}\")\n    print(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    lines = analyze_bytes(data, start_va)\n    for line in lines:\n        # Highlight key addresses\n        if \"0x10C24\" in line or \"0xFB70\" in line:\n            print(f\"&gt;&gt;&gt; {line} &lt;&lt;&lt; SET ROOM 21\")\n        elif \"0x10C08\" in line or \"call 0x2A342\" in line.lower():\n            print(f\"&gt;&gt;&gt; {line} &lt;&lt;&lt; file_seek\")\n        elif \"0x10C75\" in line or \"0x10CF1\" in line:\n            print(f\"&gt;&gt;&gt; {line}\")\n        else:\n            print(f\"    {line}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze the conversation dispatch table and Egypt code more carefully.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\ndef va_to_file(va):\n    if va &gt;= DATA_VA_BASE:\n        return va - DATA_VA_BASE + DATA_FILE_BASE\n    elif va &gt;= CODE_VA_BASE:\n        return va - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\n    return va\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    # Read raw bytes at table 0x47E58\n    table_va = 0x47E58\n    f.seek(va_to_file(table_va))\n    data = f.read(0x80)\n    \n    print(f\"Raw bytes at conversation dispatch table 0x{table_va:05X}:\")\n    print(\"=\"*70)\n    for i in range(0, len(data), 16):\n        va = table_va + i\n        hex_str = \" \".join(f\"{b:02X}\" for b in data[i:i+16])\n        print(f\"{va:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n    \n    print()\n    print(\"Parsing as 6-byte entries:\")\n    for i in range(0, 60, 6):\n        action_id = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[i:i+2])[0]\n        func_ptr = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", data[i+2:i+6])[0]\n        if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"  Entry {i//6}: END\")\n            break\n        print(f\"  Entry {i//6}: ID={action_id} (0x{action_id:03X}) ptr=0x{func_ptr:05X}\")\n    \n    # Now look at the function at 0x1098F which appears to be the Egypt travel handler\n    print()\n    print(\"=\"*70)\n    print(\"Looking at Egypt travel function starting at 0x1098F:\")\n    print(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    func_va = 0x1098F\n    f.seek(va_to_file(func_va))\n    code = f.read(0x400)\n    \n    # The function at 0x1098F pushes 0x30 and then calls something\n    # Let's look for where the Egypt screen data is loaded\n    \n    # Search for the Egypt screen offset 0x0B11F1 or related patterns\n    for i in range(len(code) -   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract and analyze Room 5 (Egypt map) sprite data from ALFRED.1\nto understand what sprite 2 is (the animated flight path element)\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\n# Room directory structure for ALFRED.1\nROOM_DIR_ENTRY_SIZE = 8  # offset (4) + size (4)\nROOM_PAIRS_COUNT = 13\nROOM_5_INDEX = 5\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    # Read room 5 directory entry\n    room_dir_offset = ROOM_5_INDEX * ROOM_PAIRS_COUNT * ROOM_DIR_ENTRY_SIZE\n    f.seek(room_dir_offset)\n    \n    print(\"Room 5 (Egypt Map) Data Offsets from ALFRED.1:\")\n    print(\"=\" * 60)\n    \n    for pair_idx in range(ROOM_PAIRS_COUNT):\n        offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n        size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n        print(f\"  Pair {pair_idx:2d}: offset=0x{offset:08X}, size=0x{size:04X} ({size})\")\n\n    # Pair 0 is sprite data (room data header)\n    f.seek(room_dir_offset)\n    pair0_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n    pair0_size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n    \n    print(f\"\\nRoom 5 main data (Pair 0) at 0x{pair0_offset:08X}:\")\n    print(\"-\" * 60)\n    \n    # Read room data\n    f.seek(pair0_offset)\n    room_data = f.read(0x200)  # Read enough for sprite structures\n    \n    # Room data starts with header, then sprites at offset +0x58 for sprite 2\n    # But first let's check how many sprites there are\n    \n    # sprite_count is typically at offset +0x05\n    sprite_count = room_data[0x05]\n    print(f\"  Sprite count: {sprite_count}\")\n    \n    # Parse sprite 2 (at offset 0x58 = 2 * 0x2C)\n    SPRITE_2_OFFSET = 0x58\n    \n    if len(room_data) &gt; SPRITE_2_OFFSET + 0x2C:\n        sprite2 = room_data[SPRITE_2_OFFSET:SPRITE_2_OFFSET + 0x2C]\n        \n        print(f\"\\nSprite 2 structure (offset 0x58, 44 bytes):\")\n        print(f\"  Raw bytes: {' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in sprite2)}\")\n        \n        # Parse known fields\n        graphic_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', sprite2[0x06:0x0A])[0]\n        x_coord = struct.unpack('&lt;h', sprite2[0x0A:0x0C])[0]\n        y_coord = struct.unpack('&lt;h', sprite2[0x0C:0x0E])[0]\n        width = sprite2[0x0E]\n        height = sprite2[0x0F]\n        stride = struct.unpack('&lt;H', sprite2[0x10:0x12])[0]\n        num_sequences = sprite2[0x12]\n        cur_sequence = sprite2[0x13]\n        z_depth = sprite2[0x21]\n        \n        print(f\"\\n  Parsed fields:\")\n        print(f\"    Graphics pointer: 0x{graphic_ptr:08X}\")\n        print(f\"    Initial X: {x_coord}\")\n        print(f\"    Initial Y: {y_coord}\")\n        print(f\"    Width: {width}\")\n        print(f\"    Height: {height}\")\n        print(f\"    Stride: {stride}\")\n        print(f\"    Num sequences: {num_sequences}\")\n        print(f\"    Current sequence: {cur_sequence}\")\n        print(f\"    Z-depth: {z_depth} (0xFF=disabled)\")\n        \n        # Movement flags at +0x22\n        mov_flags = struct.unpack('&lt;H', sprite2[0x22:0x24])[0]\n        print(f\"\\n    Movement flags: 0x{mov_flags:04X}\")\n        if mov_flags:\n            print(f\"      Amount (bits 0-2): {mov_flags &amp; 0x07}\")\n            print(f\"      X enable (bit 3): {bool(mov_flags &amp; 0x08)}\")\n            print(f\"      X direction (bit 4): {'right' if mov_flags &amp; 0x10 else 'left'}\")\n            y_speed = (mov_flags &gt;&gt;   "textEditContent": "# Egypt Travel Animation System Documentation\n\n## Overview\n\nThe Egypt travel animation displays when Alfred travels from the travel agency (Room 20) to Egypt. It shows a map of Europe and North Africa with an animated flight path showing Alfred's journey.\n\n## Key Discovery\n\n**The animation is NOT hardcoded line drawing.** Instead, it uses the game's built-in **sprite movement system** with movement flags that automatically update sprite positions each frame.\n\n## Data Sources\n\n### Map Background (Room 5 in ALFRED.7)\n\nThe Egypt travel map is stored as \"Room 5\" graphics in ALFRED.7. It's not a real game room - it's repurposed as a transition screen.\n\n| Block | File Offset | Size | Purpose |\n|-------|-------------|------|---------|\n| 0 | 0x000B11F1 | 0x5CF8 | Top-left background |\n| 1 | 0x000B6EE9 | 0x712E | Background block 2 |\n| 2 | 0x000BE017 | 0x725C | Background block 3 |\n| 3 | 0x000C5273 | 0x6A5E | Background block 4 |\n| 4 | 0x000CBCD1 | 0x50C2 | Background block 5 |\n| 5 | 0x000D0D93 | 0x4642 | Background block 6 |\n| 6 | 0x000D53D5 | 0x51B8 | Background block 7 |\n| 7 | 0x000DA58D | 0x3A84 | Bottom background |\n| Palette | 0x000DE011 | 0x0300 | VGA palette (768 bytes) |\n\nRoom 5 entry is at VA 0x48A02 in the Room Graphics Table (base 0x488F4).\n\n### Animation Function\n\nThe Egypt animation is handled by a function at VA **0x1098F** (file offset 0x1478F in JUEGO.EXE).\n\nThis function is triggered via the **conversation dispatch table** at VA 0x47E58. Action ID 257 (0x101) in conversations triggers this handler.\n\n## Animation Mechanism\n\n### Sprite 2 as the Flight Path\n\nThe animation uses **Sprite 2** from the room data structure:\n- Sprite 2 base offset: &#96;room_sprite_data_ptr + 0x58&#96;\n- Sprite 2 X coordinate: &#96;room_sprite_data_ptr + 0x62&#96; (offset 0x0A in sprite)\n- Sprite 2 Y coordinate: &#96;room_sprite_data_ptr + 0x64&#96; (offset 0x0C in sprite)\n- Movement flags: &#96;room_sprite_data_ptr + 0x7A&#96; (offset 0x22 in sprite)\n\n### Movement Flags (16-bit)\n\nThe movement flags at offset 0x22 in each sprite structure control automatic per-frame movement:\n\n| Bits | Mask | Purpose |\n|------|------|---------|\n| 0-2 | 0x0007 | Movement amount (0-7 pixels/frame) |\n| 3 | 0x0008 | X direction: 0=left, 1=right |\n| 4 | 0x0010 | X axis enable |\n| 5-7 | 0x00E0 | Y movement amount (0-7 pixels/frame) |\n| 8 | 0x0100 | Y direction: 0=up, 1=down |\n| 9 | 0x0200 | Y axis enable |\n| 14 | 0x4000 | Z-depth enable |\n| 13 | 0x2000 | Z-depth direction |\n\n### Animation Sequence\n\nThe function runs 3 animation loops, each with different movement flags:\n\n#### Loop 1: Eastward (Right)\n- **Address**: 0x10AF3 - 0x10B12\n- **Movement flags**: 0x001C\n  - Amount: 4 pixels/frame\n  - X enable: Yes\n  - X direction: Right\n- **Condition**: Loop while sprite2.X &lt; 339, exit when X &gt;= 339\n- **Visual**: Flight path moves right across Europe\n\n#### Loop 2: Southward (Down)\n- **Address**: 0x10B1A - 0x10B39\n- **Movement flags**: 0x0340\n  - Y amount: 2 pixels/frame\n  - Y enable: Yes\n  - Y direction: Down\n- **Condition**: Loop while sprite2.Y &lt; 206, exit when Y &gt;= 206\n- **Visual**: Flight path moves down toward Mediterranean\n\n#### Loop 3: Toward Egypt (Left)\n- **Address**: 0x10B41 - 0x10B60\n- **Movement flags**: 0x0014\n  - Amount: 4 pixels/frame\n  - X enable: Yes\n  - X direction: Left\n- **Condition**: Loop while sprite2.X &gt; 307, exit when X &lt;= 307\n- **Visual**: Flight path moves left/southwest to Egypt location\n\n### Loop Structure\n\nEach loop follows the same pattern:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nloop:\n    mov eax, [room_sprite_data_ptr]    ; 0x0FAC8\n    xor ecx, ecx\n    mov cx, [eax+0x62]                 ; Get sprite2 X\n    cmp ecx, TARGET\n    jxx exit_loop                       ; Check condition\n    call setup_alfred_frame_from_state  ; 0x147C9\n    call render_scene                   ; 0x15E4C - updates sprite positions!\n    jmp loop\nexit_loop:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe key is that &#96;render_scene&#96; calls &#96;update_npc_sprite_animations&#96;, which automatically updates sprite positions based on movement flags each frame.\n\n## Initialization\n\nBefore the animation loops, the function:\n\n1. **Sets sprite2 Z-depth** to 0xFE (visible) at 0x10ADA\n2. **Sets movement flags** to 0x001C (move right) at 0x10AE3\n3. **Adjusts Y coordinate** by subtracting 25 at 0x10AEE\n\n## Destination Room\n\nAfter the animation completes, the function sets:\n- &#96;[0x0FB70] = 21&#96; Player talks to travel agent\n2. Conversation text contains control code (0xF8/0xEB)\n3. Control code specifies Action ID 257\n4. &#96;handle_conversation_tree&#96; (0x18690) dispatches to table at 0x47E58\n5. Action 257 handler at 0x10C76 executes (inside Egypt function)\n\n## Conclusion\n\nThe Egypt travel animation is **data-driven** through:\n- Sprite graphics stored in ALFRED.7 (Room 5 data)\n- Movement flags that specify direction and speed\n- Target coordinates that control when each segment ends\n\nThe only hardcoded elements are:\n- The 3 target X/Y coordinates (339, 206, 307)\n- The movement flag values for each segment\n- The initial Y adjustment (-25)\n\nFor ScummVM reimplementation, this can be implemented using the standard sprite movement system with the documented movement flags and target coordinates.\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCheck what's at offset 0x65E5 in Room 5 data\nRoom 5 entry in ALFRED.1 starts at 0x00128204\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\n# Room 5 data from ALFRED.1\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    # Room directory\n    f.seek(0)\n    dir_data = f.read(56 * 26)  # 56 rooms * 13 pairs * 2 bytes\n    \n    # Room 5 entry (0-indexed)\n    room5_entry = 5 * 26\n    offset = struct.unpack('&lt;H', dir_data[room5_entry:room5_entry+2])[0]\n    size = struct.unpack('&lt;H', dir_data[room5_entry+2:room5_entry+4])[0]\n    \n    # Calculate actual offset\n    actual_offset = 0\n    for r in range(5):\n        entry = r * 26\n        for p in range(13):\n            _, s = struct.unpack('&lt;HH', dir_data[entry+p*4:entry+p*4+4])\n            actual_offset += s\n    \n    actual_offset = 0x00128204  # From earlier analysis\n    \n    print(f\"Room 5 data at file offset: 0x{actual_offset:08X}\")\n    print(f\"Room 5 size: {size} bytes\")\n    print()\n    \n    # Read room 5 data\n    f.seek(actual_offset)\n    room5_data = f.read(0x7000)  # Read plenty\n    \n    # Check offset 0x65E5\n    if len(room5_data) &gt;= 0x65E5 + 100:\n        print(f\"Data at offset 0x65E5 (would be source of memcpy):\")\n        snippet = room5_data[0x65E5:0x65E5+64]\n        for j in range(0, 64, 16):\n            hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in snippet[j:j+16])\n            print(f\"  +0x{0x65E5+j:04X}: {hex_str}\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"Room 5 data is only {len(room5_data)} bytes, offset 0x65E5 is beyond end!\")\n        print(f\"This means the Egypt function loads different/additional data first!\")\n    \n    print()\n    \n    #   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze Room 5 offset 0x65E5 - the source of the Egypt animation sprite data\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    # Room 5 data starts at 0x00128204\n    f.seek(0x00128204 + 0x65E5)\n    data = f.read(200)\n\nprint(\"Room 5 data at offset 0x65E5 (Egypt sprite source)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint()\n\n# Hex dump\nprint(\"First 128 bytes:\")\nfor i in range(0, 128, 16):\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{data[i+j]:02X}' for j in range(16))\n    ascii_str = ''.join(chr(data[i+j]) if 32 &lt;= data[i+j] &lt; 127 else '.' for j in range(16))\n    print(f\"  +{i:04X}: {hex_str}  {ascii_str}\")\n\nprint()\n\n# Try to interpret as sprite header structure\n# Sprite structure (0x2C = 44 bytes):\n#   0x00: word - gfx_offset_low\n#   0x02: word - gfx_offset_high  \n#   0x04: word - palette_index?\n#   0x06: dword - frame_ptr\n#   0x0A: word - X\n#   0x0C: word - Y\n#   0x0E: byte - width\n#   0x0F: byte - height\n#   0x10: word - ?\n#   ...\n#   0x21: byte - z_depth\n#   0x22: word - mov_flags\n\nprint(\"Interpreting as sprite structure:\")\nif len(data) &gt;= 0x2C:\n    x = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[0x0A:0x0C])[0]\n    y = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[0x0C:0x0E])[0]\n    width = data[0x0E]\n    height = data[0x0F]\n    z = data[0x21]\n    flags = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[0x22:0x24])[0]\n    print(f\"  X: {x}, Y: {y}\")\n    print(f\"  Width: {width}, Height: {height}\")\n    print(f\"  Z-depth: 0x{z:02X}\")\n    print(f\"  Mov_flags: 0x{flags:04X}\")\nelse:\n    print(\"  (not enough data)\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"Note: The memcpy copies 4455 bytes (0x1167)\")\nprint(\"      This is about 101 sprites (4455/44 = 101.25)\")\nprint()\n\n# Let's also look at what a complete room sprite section looks like\n# Check offset 0x58 in room 5 data (first sprite after NPC)\nprint(\"For comparison, sprite data at offset 0x58 (sprite 0):\")\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(0x00128204 + 0x58)\n    sprite0 = f.read(0x2C)\n    \nhex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in sprite0[:16])\nprint(f\"  {hex_str}\")\nhex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in sprite0[16:32])\nprint(f\"  {hex_str}\")\n",

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/check_egypt_memcpy.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/check_egypt_memcpy.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
