  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCheck what graphics data is at room+0xEE2 (destination of memcpy)\nThis is where the Egypt animation sprite data ends up.\n\nRoom 5 is ~28KB, and the memcpy copies 4455 bytes from 0x65E5 to 0xEE2.\n0x65E5 is within the room data since room is 0x6E5C bytes.\n\nLet me check what's actually at 0xEE2 in Room 5 (before the memcpy).\nAnd what's at 0x65E5 (the source).\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nroom5_offset = 0x00128204  # Room 5 start in ALFRED.1\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(room5_offset)\n    room5 = f.read(0x7000)  # 28KB+\n\nprint(f\"Room 5 size: {len(room5)} bytes (0x{len(room5):X})\")\nprint()\n\n# Check offset 0xEE2 (destination)\nprint(\"Destination: offset 0xEE2 (first 64 bytes before memcpy):\")\nfor i in range(0, 64, 16):\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{room5[0xEE2+i+j]:02X}' for j in range(16))\n    print(f\"  +0x{0xEE2+i:04X}: {hex_str}\")\n\nprint()\n\n# Check offset 0x65E5 (source) \nprint(\"Source: offset 0x65E5 (first 64 bytes):\")\nfor i in range(0, 64, 16):\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{room5[0x65E5+i+j]:02X}' for j in range(16))\n    print(f\"  +0x{0x65E5+i:04X}: {hex_str}\")\n\nprint()\n\n# The sprite array starts at offset 0x58\n# Sprite 2 is at 0x58 + 2*0x2C = 0x58 + 0x58 = 0xB0\n# Sprite 2's graphics pointer is at 0xB0 + 0x06 = 0xB6\n# But the game dynamically sets this!\n\n# What's interesting is that 0xEE2 is:\n# 0xEE2 - 0x58 = 0xE8A = 3722 bytes past sprite start\n# This doesn't align with sprite structures (0x2C = 44 bytes)\n\n# Let's check what 0xEE2 is relative to\nprint(\"Analysis:\")\nprint(f\"  Sprite array starts at: 0x58\")\nprint(f\"  Sprite 2 at: 0x58 + 0x58 = 0xB0\")\nprint(f\"  Sprite 2 graphics ptr at: 0xB0 + 0x06 = 0xB6\")\nprint()\nprint(f\"  Destination 0xEE2 is {0xEE2 - 0x58} bytes past sprite start\")\nprint(f\"  With 23 sprites (23 * 0x2C = 0x3FC), sprite array ends at: 0x58 + 0x3FC = 0x454\")\nprint()\nprint(f\"  So 0xEE2 is in the room data area, NOT sprite structures!\")\nprint(f\"  It's likely the decompressed sprite graphics buffer area\")\nprint()\n\n# Check the sprite count\nsprite_count = room5[5]\nprint(f\"Sprite count from room5[5]: {sprite_count}\")\n\n# Check what's at sprite 2's structure\nsprite2_offset = 0x58 + 2 * 0x2C\nprint(f\"\\nSprite 2 structure (at offset 0x{sprite2_offset:X}):\")\nsprite2 = room5[sprite2_offset:sprite2_offset+0x2C]\nfor i in range(0, 0x2C, 16):\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{sprite2[i+j]:02X}' for j in range(min(16, 0x2C-i)))\n    print(f\"  +{i:02X}: {hex_str}\")\n\n# Interpret key fields\ngfx_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', sprite2[6:10])[0]\nx = struct.unpack('&lt;H', sprite2[0x0A:0x0C])[0]\ny = struct.unpack('&lt;H', sprite2[0x0C:0x0E])[0]\nwidth = sprite2[0x0E]\nheight = sprite2[0x0F]\nprint(f\"\\n  gfx_ptr: 0x{gfx_ptr:08X}\")\nprint(f\"  X: {x}, Y: {y}\")\nprint(f\"  Width: {width}, Height: {height}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nThe data at offset 0x65E5 looks like it might be coordinate pairs\nfor the flight path animation. Let's analyze it as 16-bit word pairs.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nroom5_offset = 0x00128204\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(room5_offset + 0x65E5)\n    data = f.read(200)\n\nprint(\"Egypt Flight Path Data Analysis\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint()\n\n# Interpret as word pairs (X, Y coordinates?)\nprint(\"As word pairs (potential X, Y coordinates):\")\nfor i in range(0, min(80, len(data)), 4):\n    x = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[i:i+2])[0]\n    y = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[i+2:i+4])[0]\n    print(f\"  [{i//4:3d}]: X={x:4d}, Y={y:4d}\")\n\nprint()\n\n# The values range from 0x011D to 0x02E4 (285 to 740)\n# These could be screen coordinates (640x400 screen)\n\n# Let's also look at the pattern - maybe it's segment endpoints\nprint(\"Unique values in first 100 bytes:\")\nvalues = set()\nfor i in range(0, min(100, len(data)), 2):\n    val = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[i:i+2])[0]\n    values.add(val)\nprint(f\"  Count: {len(values)}\")\nprint(f\"  Range: {min(values)} - {max(values)}\")\nprint(f\"  Values: {sorted(values)[:20]}...\")\n\n# Check if values could be screen coordinates\nprint()\nprint(\"Interpretation:\")\nprint(\"  If these are X,Y pairs for path segments:\")\nprint(\"  - Screen is 640x400\")\nprint(\"  - Map appears to span ~285 to ~740 in X\")\nprint(\"  - Would need to be scaled/offset\")\nprint()\n\n# Let's try reading the first few as path segment definitions\nprint(\"First 20 word values (potential path data):\")\nfor i in range(0, 40, 2):\n    val = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[i:i+2])[0]\n    print(f\"  [{i//2:2d}]: {val:4d} (0x{val:04X})\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nLook for writes to sprites OTHER than sprite 2 in the Egypt function.\nMaybe the flight path is drawn by progressively revealing multiple sprites.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(0x1098F - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE)\n    egypt = f.read(0x600)\n\nstart_va = 0x1098F\n\nprint(\"Searching for writes to sprites other than sprite 2\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint()\n\n# Sprite offsets from room_sprite_data_ptr:\n# Sprite 0: 0x00\n# Sprite 1: 0x2C\n# Sprite 2: 0x58\n# Sprite 3: 0x84\n# Sprite 4: 0xB0\n# etc.\n\n# sprite2 accesses use offsets 0x58-0x83\n# Other sprite offsets would be different\n\n# Look for mov byte [eax+offset], imm patterns\n# where offset is NOT in sprite 2 range (0x58-0x83)\n\nprint(\"Looking for sprite-related memory writes...\")\nfor i in range(len(egypt) - 6):\n    va = start_va + i\n    \n    # mov byte [eax+disp8], imm8\n    if egypt[i:i+2] == bytes([0xC6, 0x40]):\n        disp = egypt[i+2]\n        imm = egypt[i+3]\n        # Check if it's sprite data (offset &lt;   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCheck sprite 4 in Room 5 data.\nSprite 4 is at offset 0x58 + 4*0x2C = 0x58 + 0xB0 = 0x108\nWait, that's wrong. Let me recalculate:\nSprite 0: 0x00\nSprite 1: 0x2C  \nSprite 2: 0x58\nSprite 3: 0x84\nSprite 4: 0xB0\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nroom5_offset = 0x00128204\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(room5_offset)\n    room5 = f.read(0x200)\n\nprint(\"Room 5 Sprite Structures\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\n\nfor sprite_idx in range(6):\n    offset = sprite_idx * 0x2C\n    sprite = room5[offset:offset+0x2C]\n    \n    print(f\"\\nSprite {sprite_idx} (offset 0x{offset:02X}):\")\n    \n    # Check if it's placeholder data\n    if all(b == 0xFE or b == 0x17 for b in sprite[:8]):\n        print(\"  [PLACEHOLDER DATA]\")\n        continue\n    \n    # Decode fields\n    gfx_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', sprite[6:10])[0]\n    x = struct.unpack('&lt;H', sprite[0x0A:0x0C])[0]\n    y = struct.unpack('&lt;H', sprite[0x0C:0x0E])[0]\n    width = sprite[0x0E]\n    height = sprite[0x0F]\n    stride = struct.unpack('&lt;H', sprite[0x10:0x12])[0]\n    num_seqs = sprite[0x12]\n    cur_seq = sprite[0x13]\n    z_depth = sprite[0x21]\n    frame_idx = sprite[0x20]\n    \n    print(f\"  gfx_ptr: 0x{gfx_ptr:08X}\")\n    print(f\"  X: {x}, Y: {y}\")\n    print(f\"  Width: {width}, Height: {height}, Stride: {stride}\")\n    print(f\"  Num sequences: {num_seqs}, Current: {cur_seq}\")\n    print(f\"  Z-depth: 0x{z_depth:02X}, Frame: {frame_idx}\")\n    \n    # Movement flags at offset 0x22 + seq*2\n    mov_flags = struct.unpack('&lt;H', sprite[0x22:0x24])[0]\n    print(f\"  Movement flags: 0x{mov_flags:04X}\")\n    \n    # Raw hex for first 16 bytes\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in sprite[:16])\n    print(f\"  Raw[0:16]: {hex_str}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze the graphics data at Room 5 offset 0x65E5.\nThis is 4455 bytes that get copied to offset 0xEE2 for the Egypt animation.\n\nIf this is raw sprite graphics (width * height = size):\n- 4455 could be 99x45, 165x27, 297x15, etc.\n\nLet's look for patterns that might indicate:\n1. RLE compression\n2. Raw pixel data\n3. Animation frame headers\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nroom5_offset = 0x00128204\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(room5_offset + 0x65E5)\n    data = f.read(4455)\n\nprint(\"Egypt Animation Graphics Data Analysis\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint(f\"Size: {len(data)} bytes (0x{len(data):X})\")\nprint()\n\n# Check for common patterns\nprint(\"First 128 bytes:\")\nfor i in range(0, 128, 16):\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{data[i]:02X}' for _ , data[i] in enumerate(data[i:i+16]))\n    print(f\"  +{i:04X}: {' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in data[i:i+16])}\")\n\n# Check for 0xFF transparency markers\nff_count = data.count(0xFF)\nprint(f\"\\n0xFF (transparency) count: {ff_count} ({ff_count*100//len(data)}%)\")\n\n# Check for structure - maybe it's multiple sprite frames\n# Look for patterns that repeat\nprint(\"\\nLooking for repeating patterns...\")\nunique_bytes = set(data)\nprint(f\"Unique byte values: {len(unique_bytes)}\")\n\n# If most values are in a small range, it's likely palette indices\nvalue_counts = {}\nfor b in data:\n    value_counts[b] = value_counts.get(b, 0) + 1\n\nmost_common = sorted(value_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:10]\nprint(\"Most common values:\")\nfor val, count in most_common:\n    print(f\"  0x{val:02X}: {count} times ({count*100//len(data)}%)\")\n\n# Check if it could be RLE compressed\n# RLE typically has run-length + value pairs\nprint(\"\\nPotential RLE analysis:\")\nprint(\"  If RLE: look for repeating count+value patterns\")\n# Check first 20 bytes as potential RLE\nfor i in range(0, 20, 2):\n    count = data[i]\n    value = data[i+1]\n    print(f\"  [{i//2}]: count={count}, value=0x{value:02X}\")\n",

Find who accesses that table entry\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"HANDLER AT 0x11449 (Action 279)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nhandler_va = 0x11449\nhandler_file = handler_va - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\ncode = exe[handler_file:handler_file+0x100]\n\nprint(\"First 64 bytes of handler code:\")\nfor i in range(0, 64, 16):\n    va = handler_va + i\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in code[i:i+16])\n    print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n\nprint()\n\n# Quick decode of first few instructions\nprint(\"Quick decode:\")\ni = 0\nfor _ in range(20):\n    if i &gt;= len(code):\n        break\n    va = handler_va + i\n    b = code[i]\n    \n    # push imm8\n    if b == 0x6A:\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: push 0x{code[i+1]:02X} ({code[i+1]})\")\n        i += 2\n        continue\n    # push imm32\n    if b == 0x68:\n        imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[i+1:i+5])[0]\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: push 0x{imm:08X}\")\n        i += 5\n        continue\n    # call rel32\n    if b == 0xE8:\n        rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', code[i+1:i+5])[0]\n        target = va + 5 + rel\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: call 0x{target:05X}\")\n        i += 5\n        continue\n    # mov eax, [addr]\n    if b == 0xA1:\n        addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[i+1:i+5])[0]\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: mov eax, [0x{addr:05X}]\")\n        i += 5\n        continue\n    # ret\n    if b == 0xC3:\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: ret\")\n        i += 1\n        continue\n    # add esp, imm8\n    if code[i:i+2] == bytes([0x83, 0xC4]):\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: add esp, 0x{code[i+2]:02X}\")\n        i += 3\n        continue\n        \n    print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: {code[i]:02X} ...\")\n    i += 1\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"ROOM GRAPHICS TABLE (where 0x0B11F1 appears)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# The offset 0x0B11F1 was found at VA 0x48A02\n# This appears to be the Room Graphics Table\n# Let's find the table structure\n\n# Room 5 (index 5) should contain 0x0B11F1\n# Table base is likely 0x488F4 (from earlier analysis)\ntable_base_va = 0x488F4\ntable_base_file = table_base_va - DATA_VA_BASE + DATA_FILE_BASE\n\n# Each room entry is 0x36 bytes (54 bytes) with 13 pairs of offset+size\n# Actually let's check the entry size by looking at spacing\noffset_found_va = 0x48A02\noffset_from_base = offset_found_va - table_base_va\nprint(f\"  Offset 0x0B11F1 found at VA 0x{offset_found_va:05X}\")\nprint(f\"  Table base: VA 0x{table_base_va:05X}\")\nprint(f\"  Offset from base: 0x{offset_from_base:X} ({offset_from_base} bytes)\")\n\n# If entry size is 0x68 (104 bytes) per room, room 5 would be at offset 5*0x68 = 0x208\n# If entry size is 0x36 (54 bytes), room 5 would be at offset 5*0x36 = 0x10E\nentry_size = offset_from_base // 5 if offset_from_base &gt; 0 else 0x68\nprint(f\"  If room 5, entry size would be: 0x{entry_size:X} bytes\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"Dumping table entries around room 5:\")\n# Dump 3 entries around where we found the offset\nfor room in range(4, 7):\n    entry_file = table_base_file + room * 0x68  # Try 0x68 entry size\n    entry_va = table_base_va + room * 0x68\n    \n    print(f\"\\n  Room {room} (VA 0x{entry_va:05X}):\")\n    \n    # First 8 pairs (offset:4, size:4)\n    for pair in range(9):\n        pair_off = pair * 8\n        offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', exe[entry_file+pair_off:entry_file+pair_off+4])[0]\n        size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', exe[entry_file+pair_off+4:entry_file+pair_off+8])[0]\n        if offset != 0:\n            print(f\"    Block {pair}: offset=0x{offset:08X}, size=0x{size:X}\")\n",

Trace back from the room 21 set locations\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"PART 1: Find the Room Graphics Table containing 0x0B11F1\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# 0x0B11F1 was found at file offset 0x04BC02, VA 0x48A02\n# Let's examine the area around it to understand the structure\n\ntarget_file = 0x04BC02\ntarget_va = 0x48A02\n\nprint(f\"Context around VA 0x{target_va:05X} (file 0x{target_file:06X}):\")\nprint()\n\n# Dump 128 bytes before and after\nstart = target_file - 64\nfor i in range(0, 192, 16):\n    file_off = start + i\n    va = file_off - DATA_FILE_BASE + DATA_VA_BASE\n    data = exe[file_off:file_off+16]\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in data)\n    marker = \" &lt;-- 0x0B11F1 here\" if target_file &gt;= file_off and target_file &lt; file_off + 16 else \"\"\n    print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: {hex_str}{marker}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"PART 2: Search for CD track play patterns more broadly\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# The CD play function might use different calling conventions\n# Let's search for any reference to value 26 near known CD functions\n\n# Look for 0x1A (26) as an immediate value in various forms\nprint(\"Searching for value 26 (0x1A) in code section:\")\nresults = []\ncode_start = CODE_FILE_BASE\ncode_end = CODE_FILE_BASE + 0x30000\n\nfor i in range(code_start, min(code_end, len(exe) - 10)):\n    # push 0x1A followed by call\n    if exe[i] == 0x6A and exe[i+1] == 0x1A:\n        va = i - CODE_FILE_BASE + CODE_VA_BASE\n        # Look for call within 30 bytes\n        for j in range(i+2, min(i+30, len(exe)-5)):\n            if exe[j] == 0xE8:\n                rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', exe[j+1:j+5])[0]\n                target_va = (j - CODE_FILE_BASE + CODE_VA_BASE) + 5 + rel\n                results.append((va, j-i, target_va))\n                break\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(results)} 'push 0x1A' followed by call:\")\nfor va, dist, target in results[:20]:\n    print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: push 0x1A, call 0x{target:05X} at +{dist}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"PART 3: Analyze locations that set room to 21\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Found: 0x100E8, 0x10C24, 0x10C96\nlocations = [0x100E8, 0x10C24, 0x10C96]\n\nfor loc in locations:\n    print(f\"\\n--- Location 0x{loc:05X} ---\")\n    file_off = loc - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\n    \n    # Read 100 bytes before to find function start\n    before = exe[file_off-100:file_off+20]\n    \n    # Look for common function prologs going backwards\n    func_start = None\n    for offset in range(100, 0, -1):\n        # push ebp\n        if before[100-offset] == 0x55:\n            func_start = loc - offset\n            break\n        # push imm32 at potential function start\n        if before[100-offset] == 0x68:\n            # Check if followed by reasonable code\n            func_start = loc - offset\n            break\n    \n    if func_start:\n        print(f\"  Possible function start: 0x{func_start:05X}\")\n    \n    # Show context\n    ctx = exe[file_off-20:file_off+20]\n    print(f\"  Context before/after:\")\n    for i in range(0, 40, 16):\n        ctx_va = loc - 20 + i\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in ctx[i:i+16])\n        marker = \" &lt;-- set room 21\" if i &gt;= 16 and i &lt; 32 else \"\"\n        print(f\"    0x{ctx_va:05X}: {hex_str}{marker}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSearch for the Egypt animation more thoroughly:\n1. Find calls to play_cd_audio_track (0x28D32)\n2. Look for extra screen loading functions\n3. Trace the function containing the room 21 set at 0x10C24\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"PART 1: All calls to play_cd_audio_track (0x28D32)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\ntarget_func = 0x28D32\nresults = []\n\nfor i in range(CODE_FILE_BASE, CODE_FILE_BASE + 0x30000):\n    if exe[i] == 0xE8:\n        rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', exe[i+1:i+5])[0]\n        va = i - CODE_FILE_BASE + CODE_VA_BASE\n        call_target = va + 5 + rel\n        if call_target == target_func:\n            results.append(va)\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(results)} calls to play_cd_audio_track:\")\nfor va in results:\n    file_off = va - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\n    # Look at push before the call\n    before = exe[file_off-20:file_off]\n    print(f\"  0x{va:05X}\")\n    # Check for push immediate before call\n    for j in range(len(before)-1, -1, -1):\n        if before[j] == 0x6A:  # push imm8\n            track = before[j+1]\n            print(f\"    -&gt; push 0x{track:02X} ({track}) at offset -{len(before)-j}\")\n            break\n        elif before[j] == 0x68:  # push imm32\n            track = struct.unpack('&lt;I', before[j+1:j+5])[0]\n            print(f\"    -&gt; push 0x{track:X} ({track}) at offset -{len(before)-j}\")\n            break\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"PART 2: Disassemble function containing 0x10C24 (set room 21)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# We saw the function might start around 0x10BD6\n# Let's trace back to find the actual function start\n\nloc = 0x10C24\nfile_off = loc - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\n\n# Search backwards for push ebp (0x55) or push imm32 (0x68) that starts a function\nfor scan_back in range(500):\n    check_off = file_off - scan_back\n    if check_off &lt; CODE_FILE_BASE:\n        break\n    \n    # Look for function prolog patterns\n    b = exe[check_off]\n    \n    # push ebp; mov ebp, esp\n    if exe[check_off:check_off+3] == bytes([0x55, 0x89, 0xE5]):\n        func_start = loc - scan_back\n        print(f\"Found standard prolog at 0x{func_start:05X}\")\n        break\n    \n    # push imm32 followed by reasonable code\n    if b == 0x68 and exe[check_off+5:check_off+6] == bytes([0xE8]):\n        func_start = loc - scan_back\n        print(f\"Found push+call pattern at 0x{func_start:05X}\")\n        break\n    \n    # ret (end of previous function)\n    if b == 0xC3:\n        func_start = loc - scan_back + 1\n        print(f\"Found ret at 0x{loc - scan_back:05X}, function starts at 0x{func_start:05X}\")\n        break\n\n# Disassemble from func_start\nprint(f\"\\nDisassembling from 0x{func_start:05X}:\")\nfunc_file = func_start - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\ncode = exe[func_file:func_file+0x200]\n\npos = 0\nfor _ in range(50):\n    if pos &gt;= len(code):\n        break\n    va = func_start + pos\n    b = code[pos]\n    \n    # push imm8\n    if b == 0x6A:\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: push 0x{code[pos+1]:02X} ({code[pos+1]})\")\n        pos += 2\n        continue\n    # push imm32\n    if b == 0x68:\n        imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: push 0x{imm:08X}\")\n        pos += 5\n        continue\n    # call\n    if b == 0xE8:\n        rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n        target = va + 5 + rel\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: call 0x{target:05X}\")\n        pos += 5\n        continue\n    # mov word [addr], imm16\n    if code[pos:pos+2] == bytes([0x66, 0xC7]) and code[pos+2] == 0x05:\n        addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+3:pos+7])[0]\n        imm = struct.unpack('&lt;H', code[pos+7:pos+9])[0]\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: mov word [0x{addr:05X}], 0x{imm:04X}\")\n        pos += 9\n        continue\n    # add esp, imm8\n    if code[pos:pos+2] == bytes([0x83, 0xC4]):\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: add esp, 0x{code[pos+2]:02X}\")\n        pos += 3\n        continue\n    # mov eax, [addr]\n    if b == 0xA1:\n        addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: mov eax, [0x{addr:05X}]\")\n        pos += 5\n        continue\n    # ret\n    if b == 0xC3:\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: ret\")\n        break\n    # jmp short\n    if b == 0xEB:\n        rel = struct.unpack('b', code[pos+1:pos+2])[0]\n        target = va + 2 + rel\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: jmp short 0x{target:05X}\")\n        pos += 2\n        continue\n    # cond jumps\n    if 0x70 &lt;= b &lt;= 0x7F:\n        rel = struct.unpack('b', code[pos+1:pos+2])[0]\n        target = va + 2 + rel\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: jcc 0x{target:05X}\")\n        pos += 2\n        continue\n        \n    print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: {b:02X}...\")\n    pos += 1\n",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDump the F8 dispatch table at 0x47E58 (from handle_dialog_interaction).\nFormat: 6-byte entries (2-byte action code + 4-byte function pointer)\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\ntable_va = 0x47E58\ntable_file = table_va - DATA_VA_BASE + DATA_FILE_BASE\n\nprint(\"F8 Dispatch Table at VA 0x47E58\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint(f\"{'Entry':&lt;6} {'Action':&lt;8} {'Handler':&lt;12} {'Handler Hex'}\")\nprint(\"-\" * 60)\n\nfor i in range(50):  # Check up to 50 entries\n    off = table_file + i * 6\n    action_code = struct.unpack('&lt;h', exe[off:off+2])[0]\n    handler = struct.unpack('&lt;I', exe[off+2:off+6])[0]\n    \n    if action_code == -1:\n        print(f\"{i:&lt;6} END OF TABLE\")\n        break\n    \n    marker = \"\"\n    if action_code == 279:\n        marker = \" &lt;-- ACTION 279 (EGYPT)\"\n    elif action_code == 257:\n        marker = \" &lt;-- ACTION 257\"\n    \n    print(f\"{i:&lt;6} {action_code:&lt;8} 0x{handler:08X} {marker}\")\n\n# Now show more context around the Egypt action 279 handler if found\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"SEARCHING for action 279 in table...\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\n\nfor i in range(50):\n    off = table_file + i * 6\n    action_code = struct.unpack('&lt;h', exe[off:off+2])[0]\n    handler = struct.unpack('&lt;I', exe[off+2:off+6])[0]\n    \n    if action_code == -1:\n        break\n    if action_code == 279:\n        print(f\"\\nFOUND: Entry {i}, action {action_code}, handler 0x{handler:08X}\")\n        print(f\"\\nHex dump of table entry:\")\n        entry = exe[off:off+6]\n        print(f\"  {entry.hex()}\")\n        break\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDisassemble the Egypt animation handler at 0x11449.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\nhandler_va = 0x11449\nfile_off = handler_va - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\n\nprint(f\"Disassembling handler at VA 0x{handler_va:05X}\")\nprint(f\"File offset: 0x{file_off:X}\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Hex dump first\nprint(\"\\nRaw hex dump (first 256 bytes):\")\nfor row in range(16):\n    addr = handler_va + row * 16\n    off = file_off + row * 16\n    hexdata = exe[off:off+16].hex()\n    hexfmt = ' '.join(hexdata[i:i+2] for i in range(0, len(hexdata), 2))\n    print(f\"  0x{addr:05X}: {hexfmt}\")\n\n# Manually disassemble common patterns\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Manual disassembly:\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\ncode = exe[file_off:file_off+300]\npos = 0\nlines = []\n\nwhile pos &lt; 250:\n    va = handler_va + pos\n    b = code[pos]\n    line = \"\"\n    \n    # ret\n    if b == 0xC3:\n        line = \"ret\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 1\n        continue\n    \n    # push imm8\n    if b == 0x6A:\n        imm = code[pos+1]\n        line = f\"push 0x{imm:02X} ({imm})\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 2\n        continue\n    \n    # push imm32\n    if b == 0x68:\n        imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n        line = f\"push 0x{imm:08X}\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 5\n        continue\n    \n    # call rel32\n    if b == 0xE8:\n        rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n        target = va + 5 + rel\n        line = f\"call 0x{target:05X}\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 5\n        continue\n    \n    # jmp rel8\n    if b == 0xEB:\n        rel = struct.unpack('b', code[pos+1:pos+2])[0]\n        target = va + 2 + rel\n        line = f\"jmp short 0x{target:05X}\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 2\n        continue\n    \n    # jmp rel32\n    if b == 0xE9:\n        rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n        target = va + 5 + rel\n        line = f\"jmp 0x{target:05X}\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 5\n        continue\n    \n    # add esp, imm8\n    if code[pos:pos+2] == bytes([0x83, 0xC4]):\n        imm = code[pos+2]\n        line = f\"add esp, 0x{imm:02X}\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 3\n        continue\n    \n    # mov eax, [addr]\n    if b == 0xA1:\n        addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n        line = f\"mov eax, [0x{addr:05X}]\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 5\n        continue\n    \n    # mov [addr], eax\n    if b == 0xA3:\n        addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n        line = f\"mov [0x{addr:05X}], eax\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 5\n        continue\n    \n    # mov word ptr [addr], imm16\n    if code[pos:pos+3] == bytes([0x66, 0xC7, 0x05]):\n        addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+3:pos+7])[0]\n        imm = struct.unpack('&lt;H', code[pos+7:pos+9])[0]\n        line = f\"mov word [0x{addr:05X}], 0x{imm:04X} ({imm})\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 9\n        continue\n    \n    # mov byte ptr [addr], imm8\n    if code[pos:pos+2] == bytes([0xC6, 0x05]):\n        addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n        imm = code[pos+6]\n        line = f\"mov byte [0x{addr:05X}], 0x{imm:02X} ({imm})\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 7\n        continue\n    \n    # xor reg, reg (31 xx)\n    if b == 0x31:\n        modrm = code[pos+1]\n        if modrm == 0xC0:\n            line = \"xor eax, eax\"\n        elif modrm == 0xDB:\n            line = \"xor ebx, ebx\"\n        elif modrm == 0xC9:\n            line = \"xor ecx, ecx\"\n        elif modrm == 0xD2:\n            line = \"xor edx, edx\"\n        else:\n            line = f\"xor ?, ? (31 {modrm:02X})\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 2\n        continue\n    \n    # cond jumps (0x70-0x7F)\n    if 0x70 &lt;= b &lt;= 0x7F:\n        jcc_names = ['jo', 'jno', 'jb', 'jnb', 'jz', 'jnz', 'jbe', 'ja', \n                     'js', 'jns', 'jp', 'jnp', 'jl', 'jge', 'jle', 'jg']\n        rel = struct.unpack('b', code[pos+1:pos+2])[0]\n        target = va + 2 + rel\n        line = f\"{jcc_names[b-0x70]} 0x{target:05X}\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 2\n        continue\n    \n    # Near cond jumps (0F 8x)\n    if b == 0x0F and 0x80 &lt;= code[pos+1] &lt;= 0x8F:\n        jcc_names = ['jo', 'jno', 'jb', 'jnb', 'jz', 'jnz', 'jbe', 'ja', \n                     'js', 'jns', 'jp', 'jnp', 'jl', 'jge', 'jle', 'jg']\n        rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', code[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n        target = va + 6 + rel\n        line = f\"{jcc_names[code[pos+1]-0x80]} near 0x{target:05X}\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 6\n        continue\n    \n    # 25 xx xx xx xx = and eax, imm32\n    if b == 0x25:\n        imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n        line = f\"and eax, 0x{imm:08X}\"\n        lines.append((va, line))\n        pos += 5\n        continue\n    \n    # Unknown - show bytes\n    line = f\"?? {code[pos:pos+4].hex()}\"\n    lines.append((va, line))\n    pos += 1\n\nfor va, line in lines[:80]:\n    print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: {line}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Key findings:\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Look for calls to known functions\nfor va, line in lines:\n    if 'call' in line:\n        print(f\"  CALL at 0x{va:05X}: {line}\")\n    if 'mov word' in line and '0015' in line:\n        print(f\"  SET ROOM 21 at 0x{va:05X}: {line}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDump the ALFRED.7 Room Graphics Table at 0x488F4.\nFormat: 0x36 (54) bytes per room\n- 8 entries × 6 bytes each = 48 bytes for (offset, size) pairs\n- 6 remaining bytes include palette offset at offset 0x30\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\ntable_va = 0x488F4\ntable_file = table_va - DATA_VA_BASE + DATA_FILE_BASE\nENTRY_SIZE = 0x36  # 54 bytes\n\nprint(\"ALFRED.7 Room Graphics Table at VA 0x488F4\")\nprint(\"=\" * 80)\nprint(f\"Entry size: 0x{ENTRY_SIZE:02X} ({ENTRY_SIZE}) bytes per room\")\nprint(\"Format: 8 (offset, size) pairs + palette offset at +0x30\")\nprint(\"=\" * 80)\n\n# The user said extra screen is at 0x0B11F1\n# Let's find which room entry contains this offset\ntarget_offset = 0x0B11F1\n\nprint(\"\\nSearching for offset 0x{:06X}...\".format(target_offset))\nprint(\"-\" * 80)\n\nfor room in range(56):  # 56 rooms\n    room_file_off = table_file + room * ENTRY_SIZE\n    room_data = exe[room_file_off:room_file_off + ENTRY_SIZE]\n    \n    # Check each of the 8 (offset, size) pairs\n    for block in range(8):\n        off = block * 6\n        block_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', room_data[off:off+4])[0]\n        block_size = struct.unpack('&lt;H', room_data[off+4:off+6])[0]\n        \n        if block_offset == target_offset:\n            print(f\"FOUND at Room {room}, Block {block}\")\n            print(f\"  Offset: 0x{block_offset:06X}\")\n            print(f\"  Size: 0x{block_size:04X} ({block_size})\")\n            \n            # Dump entire room entry\n            print(f\"\\n  Full room {room} entry (0x{ENTRY_SIZE:02X} bytes):\")\n            print(f\"  File offset: 0x{room_file_off:X}\")\n            for i in range(8):\n                o = i * 6\n                blk_off = struct.unpack('&lt;I', room_data[o:o+4])[0]\n                blk_sz = struct.unpack('&lt;H', room_data[o+4:o+6])[0]\n                marker = \" &lt;-- TARGET\" if blk_off == target_offset else \"\"\n                print(f\"    Block {i}: offset=0x{blk_off:06X}, size=0x{blk_sz:04X}{marker}\")\n            \n            # Palette at offset 0x30\n            pal_off = struct.unpack('&lt;I', room_data[0x30:0x34])[0]\n            print(f\"    Palette: offset=0x{pal_off:06X}\")\n            break\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 80)\nprint(\"Full table dump (first 30 rooms):\")\nprint(\"=\" * 80)\n\nfor room in range(30):\n    room_file_off = table_file + room * ENTRY_SIZE\n    room_data = exe[room_file_off:room_file_off + ENTRY_SIZE]\n    \n    # Get first block offset and palette\n    blk0_off = struct.unpack('&lt;I', room_data[0:4])[0]\n    pal_off = struct.unpack('&lt;I', room_data[0x30:0x34])[0]\n    \n    print(f\"Room {room:2d}: block0=0x{blk0_off:06X}, palette=0x{pal_off:06X}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
```

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDump the script dispatch tables used by the game:\n1. 0x47D24 - execute_room_specific_script table\n2. 0x47E58 - handle_dialog_interaction (F8) table\nAnd look for the actual Egypt animation code.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\ndef dump_dispatch_table(name, table_va, max_entries=100):\n    print(f\"\\n{'='*70}\")\n    print(f\"{name} at VA 0x{table_va:05X}\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    table_file = table_va - DATA_VA_BASE + DATA_FILE_BASE\n    \n    for i in range(max_entries):\n        off = table_file + i * 6\n        action_code = struct.unpack('&lt;H', exe[off:off+2])[0]\n        handler = struct.unpack('&lt;I', exe[off+2:off+6])[0]\n        \n        if action_code == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"  [{i:3d}] END OF TABLE\")\n            return\n        \n        marker = \"\"\n        if action_code == 279:\n            marker = \" &lt;-- EGYPT TRAVEL (279)\"\n        elif action_code == 5:\n            marker = \" &lt;-- ROOM 5?\"\n        \n        print(f\"  [{i:3d}] action={action_code:5d} (0x{action_code:04X}) -&gt; handler=0x{handler:05X}{marker}\")\n\n# Dump both tables\ndump_dispatch_table(\"execute_room_specific_script dispatch\", 0x47D24)\ndump_dispatch_table(\"handle_dialog_interaction (F8) dispatch\", 0x47E58)\n\n# Look for code that references 0x0B11F1 or 0xDE011\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Searching for code that references Egypt graphics...\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Search for mov eax, 0x0B11F1 or push 0x0B11F1\ntarget1 = 0x0B11F1\ntarget2 = 0x0DE011\n\nfor i in range(CODE_FILE_BASE, CODE_FILE_BASE + 0x30000):\n    if exe[i] == 0x68:  # push imm32\n        imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', exe[i+1:i+5])[0]\n        if imm == target1:\n            va = i - CODE_FILE_BASE + CODE_VA_BASE\n            print(f\"  Found push 0x{target1:06X} at VA 0x{va:05X}\")\n        if imm == target2:\n            va = i - CODE_FILE_BASE + CODE_VA_BASE\n            print(f\"  Found push 0x{target2:06X} at VA 0x{va:05X}\")\n    if exe[i] == 0xB8:  # mov eax, imm32\n        imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', exe[i+1:i+5])[0]\n        if imm == target1:\n            va = i - CODE_FILE_BASE + CODE_VA_BASE\n            print(f\"  Found mov eax, 0x{target1:06X} at VA 0x{va:05X}\")\n        if imm == target2:\n            va = i - CODE_FILE_BASE + CODE_VA_BASE  \n            print(f\"  Found mov eax, 0x{target2:06X} at VA 0x{va:05X}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDeep analysis of the Egypt animation handler at 0x11449.\nThis uses proper x86 disassembly patterns.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\nimport sys\n\nCODE_VA_BASE = 0x10000\nCODE_FILE_BASE = 0x14200\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000  \nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\n# Known functions for annotation\nKNOWN_FUNCS = {\n    0x27CE1: 'play_ambient_sound',\n    0x2A258: 'wait_or_process_input',\n    0x147C9: 'setup_alfred_frame_from_state',\n    0x15E4C: 'render_scene',\n    0x14751: 'load_and_blit_icon_data',\n    0x14EE3: 'load_fonts_and_graphics',\n    0x1B4A3: 'load_room_graphics_and_palette_dynamic',\n    0x1B948: 'fade_palette_to_black',\n    0x16B00: 'blit_image_to_screen',\n    0x152F5: 'load_room_and_init_alfred',\n    0x28D32: 'play_cd_audio_track',\n    0x2A6B7: 'file_read',\n    0x2A342: 'file_seek',\n    0x2662D: '??? 0x2662D',\n}\n\ndef get_func_name(addr):\n    return KNOWN_FUNCS.get(addr, '')\n\ndef disasm_call(code, pos, va):\n    rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n    target = va + 5 + rel\n    fname = get_func_name(target)\n    return 5, f\"call 0x{target:05X}  ; {fname}\" if fname else f\"call 0x{target:05X}\"\n\ndef disasm_handler(start_va, length=500):\n    file_off = start_va - CODE_VA_BASE + CODE_FILE_BASE\n    code = exe[file_off:file_off+length]\n    \n    pos = 0\n    lines = []\n    \n    while pos &lt; length - 10:\n        va = start_va + pos\n        b = code[pos]\n        \n        # ret\n        if b == 0xC3:\n            lines.append((va, 1, \"ret\"))\n            pos += 1\n            continue\n        \n        # push ebp\n        if b == 0x55:\n            lines.append((va, 1, \"push ebp\"))\n            pos += 1\n            continue\n        \n        # pop ebp\n        if b == 0x5D:\n            lines.append((va, 1, \"pop ebp\"))\n            pos += 1\n            continue\n        \n        # push regs\n        if b in [0x50, 0x51, 0x52, 0x53, 0x56, 0x57]:\n            regs = {0x50:'eax', 0x51:'ecx', 0x52:'edx', 0x53:'ebx', 0x56:'esi', 0x57:'edi'}\n            lines.append((va, 1, f\"push {regs[b]}\"))\n            pos += 1\n            continue\n        \n        # pop regs\n        if b in [0x58, 0x59, 0x5A, 0x5B, 0x5E, 0x5F]:\n            regs = {0x58:'eax', 0x59:'ecx', 0x5A:'edx', 0x5B:'ebx', 0x5E:'esi', 0x5F:'edi'}\n            lines.append((va, 1, f\"pop {regs[b]}\"))\n            pos += 1\n            continue\n        \n        # push imm8\n        if b == 0x6A:\n            imm = code[pos+1]\n            lines.append((va, 2, f\"push 0x{imm:02X}\"))\n            pos += 2\n            continue\n        \n        # push imm32\n        if b == 0x68:\n            imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n            lines.append((va, 5, f\"push 0x{imm:08X}\"))\n            pos += 5\n            continue\n        \n        # call rel32\n        if b == 0xE8:\n            size, line = disasm_call(code, pos, va)\n            lines.append((va, size, line))\n            pos += size\n            continue\n        \n        # jmp rel8\n        if b == 0xEB:\n            rel = struct.unpack('b', code[pos+1:pos+2])[0]\n            target = va + 2 + rel\n            lines.append((va, 2, f\"jmp short 0x{target:05X}\"))\n            pos += 2\n            continue\n        \n        # jmp rel32\n        if b == 0xE9:\n            rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n            target = va + 5 + rel\n            lines.append((va, 5, f\"jmp 0x{target:05X}\"))\n            pos += 5\n            continue\n        \n        # cond jump rel8\n        if 0x70 &lt;= b &lt;= 0x7F:\n            jcc = ['jo','jno','jb','jnb','jz','jnz','jbe','ja','js','jns','jp','jnp','jl','jge','jle','jg']\n            rel = struct.unpack('b', code[pos+1:pos+2])[0]\n            target = va + 2 + rel\n            lines.append((va, 2, f\"{jcc[b-0x70]} 0x{target:05X}\"))\n            pos += 2\n            continue\n        \n        # add esp, imm8\n        if code[pos:pos+2] == bytes([0x83, 0xC4]):\n            lines.append((va, 3, f\"add esp, 0x{code[pos+2]:02X}\"))\n            pos += 3\n            continue\n        \n        # xor reg, reg\n        if b == 0x31:\n            modrm = code[pos+1]\n            regs = {0xC0:'eax,eax', 0xDB:'ebx,ebx', 0xC9:'ecx,ecx', 0xD2:'edx,edx', 0xF6:'esi,esi', 0xFF:'edi,edi'}\n            if modrm in regs:\n                lines.append((va, 2, f\"xor {regs[modrm]}\"))\n            else:\n                lines.append((va, 2, f\"xor ?? (31 {modrm:02X})\"))\n            pos += 2\n            continue\n        \n        # mov al, [addr]\n        if b == 0xA0:\n            addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n            lines.append((va, 5, f\"mov al, [0x{addr:05X}]\"))\n            pos += 5\n            continue\n        \n        # mov [addr], al\n        if b == 0xA2:\n            addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n            lines.append((va, 5, f\"mov [0x{addr:05X}], al\"))\n            pos += 5\n            continue\n        \n        # mov word [addr], imm16 (66 C7 05 ...)\n        if code[pos:pos+3] == bytes([0x66, 0xC7, 0x05]):\n            addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+3:pos+7])[0]\n            imm = struct.unpack('&lt;H', code[pos+7:pos+9])[0]\n            lines.append((va, 9, f\"mov word [0x{addr:05X}], 0x{imm:04X}  ; {imm}\"))\n            pos += 9\n            continue\n        \n        # mov byte [addr], imm8 (C6 05 ...)\n        if code[pos:pos+2] == bytes([0xC6, 0x05]):\n            addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n            imm = code[pos+6]\n            lines.append((va, 7, f\"mov byte [0x{addr:05X}], 0x{imm:02X}\"))\n            pos += 7\n            continue\n        \n        # mov dword [addr], imm32 (C7 05 ...)\n        if code[pos:pos+2] == bytes([0xC7, 0x05]):\n            addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n            imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+6:pos+10])[0]\n            lines.append((va, 10, f\"mov dword [0x{addr:05X}], 0x{imm:08X}\"))\n            pos += 10\n            continue\n        \n        # mov reg, [addr] (8B xx ...)\n        if b == 0x8B:\n            modrm = code[pos+1]\n            if modrm == 0x15:  # mov edx, [addr]\n                addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n                lines.append((va, 6, f\"mov edx, [0x{addr:05X}]\"))\n                pos += 6\n                continue\n            if modrm == 0x0D:  # mov ecx, [addr]\n                addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', code[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n                lines.append((va, 6, f\"mov ecx, [0x{addr:05X}]\"))\n                pos += 6\n                continue\n            if modrm == 0x1D:  #   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSearch for the Egypt animation coordinate data.\nThe animation draws ~96 curved red line segments.\nThe coordinates might be stored as pairs (x,y) for each segment endpoint.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nDATA_VA_BASE = 0x40000\nDATA_FILE_BASE = 0x43200\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\n# The handler at 0x11449 references several data addresses:\n# - 0x13002 (byte)\n# - 0x13238 (dword) \n# - 0x13204 (dword)\n# - 0x0FB94 (word)\n# - 0x0B7F1 (table indexed by 0xFB94?)\n# - 0x095D9, 0x095DA, 0x095DB, 0x095DC, 0x095DD\n# - 0x0FAC8 (dword)\n# - 0x0FB96, 0x0FB98 (word) - set to 294 and 387\n\nprint(\"Data references from Egypt handler (0x11449):\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\ndata_refs = [\n    (0x095D9, 'byte', 'animation state 1'),\n    (0x095DA, 'byte', 'animation state 2'),\n    (0x095DB, 'byte', 'animation state 3 (0x28)'),\n    (0x095DC, 'byte', 'animation state 4'),\n    (0x095DD, 'byte', 'animation state 5'),\n    (0x0B7F1, 'table', 'indexed by current_room?'),\n    (0x0FAC8, 'dword', 'room sprite data ptr?'),\n    (0x0FB94, 'word', 'current_room_number?'),\n    (0x0FB96, 'word', 'set to 294'),\n    (0x0FB98, 'word', 'set to 387'),\n    (0x13002, 'byte', 'param to play_ambient_sound'),\n    (0x13204, 'dword', 'param to play_ambient_sound'),\n    (0x13238, 'dword', 'param to play_ambient_sound'),\n    (0x1323C, 'dword', 'param to play_ambient_sound'),\n]\n\nfor va, typ, desc in data_refs:\n    if va &gt;= DATA_VA_BASE:\n        file_off = va - DATA_VA_BASE + DATA_FILE_BASE\n    else:\n        file_off = va\n    \n    if typ == 'byte':\n        val = exe[file_off]\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: {val:02X} ({val}) - {desc}\")\n    elif typ == 'word':\n        val = struct.unpack('&lt;H', exe[file_off:file_off+2])[0]\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: {val:04X} ({val}) - {desc}\")\n    elif typ == 'dword':\n        val = struct.unpack('&lt;I', exe[file_off:file_off+4])[0]\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: {val:08X} - {desc}\")\n    elif typ == 'table':\n        print(f\"  0x{va:05X}: table - {desc}\")\n        # Dump first bytes\n        data = exe[file_off:file_off+64]\n        for i in range(4):\n            row = data[i*16:(i+1)*16]\n            hexstr = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in row)\n            print(f\"    +0x{i*16:02X}: {hexstr}\")\n\n# Now look for coordinate data\n# The flight path from London to Egypt covers roughly:\n# Start: ~500, ~150 (London area on map)\n# End: ~550, ~350 (Egypt area)\n# So we're looking for tables with values in range 0-640 (x) and 0-400 (y)\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Searching for potential coordinate tables...\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Look for tables of word pairs where values look like screen coordinates\n# Screen is 640x400, so coordinates should be 0-640 and 0-400\n\nfor search_start in range(DATA_FILE_BASE, DATA_FILE_BASE + 0x10000, 4):\n    # Check if we have a sequence of coordinate-like values\n    count = 0\n    for i in range(96):  # Looking for ~96 pairs\n        off = search_start + i * 4  # 2 words per pair\n        if off + 4 &gt; len(exe):\n            break\n        x = struct.unpack('&lt;H', exe[off:off+2])[0]\n        y = struct.unpack('&lt;H', exe[off+2:off+4])[0]\n        \n        # Check if x,y look like screen coords\n        if 50 &lt;= x &lt;= 600 and 50 &lt;= y &lt;= 380:\n            count += 1\n        else:\n            break\n    \n    if count &gt;= 50:  # Found a good sequence\n        va = search_start - DATA_FILE_BASE + DATA_VA_BASE\n        print(f\"\\nFound {count} coordinate pairs at VA 0x{va:05X} (file 0x{search_start:X})\")\n        for i in range(min(10, count)):\n            off = search_start + i * 4\n            x = struct.unpack('&lt;H', exe[off:off+2])[0]\n            y = struct.unpack('&lt;H', exe[off+2:off+4])[0]\n            print(f\"  [{i}] x={x}, y={y}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze the Egypt extra screen data in ALFRED.7.\nThe screen is at offset 0x0B11F1 and has 8 RLE blocks.\nLook for animation coordinate data after the image blocks.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/alfred.7', 'rb') as f:\n    a7 = f.read()\n\n# Room 5 entry from graphics table:\n# Block 0: offset=0x0B11F1, size=0x5CF8\n# Block 1: offset=0x0B6EE9, size=0x712E\n# ...\n# Block 7: offset=0x0DA58D, size=0x3A84\n# Palette: offset=0x0DE011\n\nblocks = [\n    (0x0B11F1, 0x5CF8),\n    (0x0B6EE9, 0x712E),\n    (0x0BE017, 0x725C),\n    (0x0C5273, 0x6A5E),\n    (0x0CBCD1, 0x50C2),\n    (0x0D0D93, 0x4642),\n    (0x0D53D5, 0x51B8),\n    (0x0DA58D, 0x3A84),\n]\n\nprint(\"ALFRED.7 Egypt Screen Blocks (Room 5 graphics):\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\ntotal_image_size = 0\nfor i, (off, size) in enumerate(blocks):\n    total_image_size += size\n    print(f\"  Block {i}: offset=0x{off:06X}, size=0x{size:04X} ({size})\")\n    \n    # Show first 16 bytes\n    data = a7[off:off+16]\n    hexstr = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in data)\n    print(f\"    Start: {hexstr}\")\n\nprint(f\"\\nTotal image data: 0x{total_image_size:X} ({total_image_size}) bytes\")\n\n# Palette location\npal_off = 0x0DE011\nprint(f\"\\nPalette at 0x{pal_off:06X}\")\npal = a7[pal_off:pal_off+768]\nprint(f\"  First 16 bytes: {' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in pal[:16])}\")\n\n# Check if there's data between the last block and palette\nlast_block_end = blocks[-1][0] + blocks[-1][1]\ngap = pal_off - last_block_end\nprint(f\"\\nGap between last block and palette: 0x{gap:X} ({gap}) bytes\")\n\nif gap &gt; 0:\n    gap_data = a7[last_block_end:pal_off]\n    print(f\"  Gap data preview:\")\n    for i in range(min(8, (gap + 15) // 16)):\n        row = gap_data[i*16:(i+1)*16]\n        hexstr = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in row)\n        print(f\"    +0x{i*16:03X}: {hexstr}\")\n\n# Also check after the palette for animation data\npost_pal = pal_off + 768\nprint(f\"\\nData after palette (0x{post_pal:06X}):\")\npost_data = a7[post_pal:post_pal+256]\nfor i in range(8):\n    row = post_data[i*16:(i+1)*16]\n    hexstr = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in row)\n    print(f\"  +0x{i*16:03X}: {hexstr}\")\n\n# Check for animation frame data - might be sprite offsets\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Looking for animation sprites or coordinate data...\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# The red line segments might be rendered using sprites\n# Check ALFRED.7 sprite table area\n# From docs: ALFRED.7 has sprites starting at certain offsets\n\n# Look for small image/sprite data after the main blocks\n# Could be individual line segment sprites\n\n# Search for patterns that look like coordinate pairs\n# X coords probably 200-500 (map area), Y coords 100-300\nfor search_off in range(last_block_end, min(pal_off, last_block_end + 4096)):\n    # Check for word pairs that look like coords\n    if search_off + 4 &lt;= len(a7):\n        x = struct.unpack('&lt;H', a7[search_off:search_off+2])[0]\n        y = struct.unpack('&lt;H', a7[search_off+2:search_off+4])[0]\n        \n        if 100 &lt;= x &lt;= 600 and 50 &lt;= y &lt;= 350:\n            print(f\"  Possible coord at 0x{search_off:06X}: ({x}, {y})\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDecompress and analyze the Egypt map animation frames from ALFRED.7\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\nimport os\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.7', 'rb') as f:\n    a7_data = f.read()\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\ndef va_to_file_data(va):\n    return va - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n\n# Room Graphics Table at VA 0x488F4\ntable_va = 0x488F4\ntable_file = va_to_file_data(table_va)\n\n# Room 5 entry\nroom5_offset = table_file + 5 * 0x36\nroom5_entry = exe_data[room5_offset:room5_offset + 0x36]\n\nblocks = []\nfor i in range(8):\n    offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', room5_entry[i*6:i*6+4])[0]\n    size = struct.unpack('&lt;H', room5_entry[i*6+4:i*6+6])[0]\n    blocks.append((offset, size))\n\npalette_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', room5_entry[0x30:0x34])[0]\n\ndef decompress_rle(data, max_output=65000):\n    \"\"\"Decompress RLE data until BUDA marker\"\"\"\n    output = []\n    pos = 0\n    while pos &lt; len(data) - 4:\n        # Check for BUDA marker\n        if data[pos:pos+4] == b'BUDA':\n            break\n        \n        count = data[pos]\n        value = data[pos + 1]\n        \n        if count == 0:\n            break\n        \n        output.extend([value] * count)\n        pos += 2\n        \n        if len(output) &gt;= max_output:\n            break\n    \n    return bytes(output)\n\nprint('=' * 70)\nprint('DECOMPRESSING EGYPT MAP ANIMATION FRAMES')\nprint('=' * 70)\n\nos.makedirs('output_egypt', exist_ok=True)\n\n# Read palette\npalette = a7_data[palette_offset:palette_offset+768]\nprint(f'Palette at 0x{palette_offset:06X}')\n\n# Analyze palette - look for red colors (for the line)\nprint('\\nLooking for red colors in palette:')\nfor i in range(256):\n    r = palette[i*3]\n    g = palette[i*3+1]\n    b = palette[i*3+2]\n    # VGA palette is 6-bit (0-63), scale to 8-bit\n    r8 = r * 4\n    g8 = g * 4\n    b8 = b * 4\n    # Look for red-ish colors (high R, low G, low B)\n    if r &gt; 40 and g &lt; 20 and b &lt; 20:\n        print(f'  Index {i}: RGB({r},{g},{b}) -&gt; scaled ({r8},{g8},{b8})')\n\nprint()\n\n# Decompress each block\nframe_sizes = []\nfor i, (offset, size) in enumerate(blocks):\n    if offset == 0 or size == 0:\n        continue\n    \n    block_data = a7_data[offset:offset+size]\n    decompressed = decompress_rle(block_data)\n    frame_sizes.append(len(decompressed))\n    \n    print(f'Block {i}: compressed={size}, decompressed={len(decompressed)}')\n    \n    # Check if decompressed size matches expected screen dimensions\n    # 320x200 = 64000, 320x25 = 8000\n    if len(decompressed) == 64000:\n        print(f'  -&gt; Full screen (320x200)!')\n    elif len(decompressed) == 8000:\n        print(f'  -&gt; Horizontal strip (320x25)!')\n    elif len(decompressed) % 320 == 0:\n        height = len(decompressed) // 320\n        print(f'  -&gt; 320x{height} pixels')\n    \n    # Save raw decompressed data for further analysis\n    with open(f'output_egypt/block_{i}.raw', 'wb') as f:\n        f.write(decompressed)\n\nprint()\nprint('=' * 70)\nprint('COMPARING FRAMES TO FIND DIFFERENCES')\nprint('=' * 70)\n\n# If these are animation frames, later frames should have more red pixels\n# (progressive reveal of flight path)\n\nfor i, (offset, size) in enumerate(blocks):\n    if offset == 0 or size == 0:\n        continue\n    \n    with open(f'output_egypt/block_{i}.raw', 'rb') as f:\n        frame = f.read()\n    \n    # Count occurrences of each color\n    red_indices = []\n    for pi in range(256):\n        r = palette[pi*3]\n        g = palette[pi*3+1]\n        b = palette[pi*3+2]\n        if r &gt; 40 and g &lt; 20 and b &lt; 20:\n            red_indices.append(pi)\n    \n    red_count = sum(frame.count(bytes([ri])) for ri in red_indices)\n    print(f'Block {i}: {red_count} red pixels')\n\nprint()\nprint('=' * 70)\nprint('ANALYZING FRAME STRUCTURE')\nprint('=' * 70)\n\n# Load block 0 and block 7 to compare\nwith open('output_egypt/block_0.raw', 'rb') as f:\n    frame0 = f.read()\nwith open('output_egypt/block_7.raw', 'rb') as f:\n    frame7 = f.read()\n\n# Check if all frames have the same size\nall_same = all(s == frame_sizes[0] for s in frame_sizes)\nprint(f'All frames same size: {all_same}')\nprint(f'Frame sizes: {frame_sizes}')\n\nif len(frame0) == len(frame7):\n    # Find differences between first and last frame\n    diff_count = sum(1 for a, b in zip(frame0, frame7) if a != b)\n    print(f'Pixels different between frame 0 and 7: {diff_count}')\n    \n    # Find positions of differences\n    diff_positions = [i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(frame0, frame7)) if a != b]\n    if diff_positions:\n        print(f'First 10 difference positions: {diff_positions[:10]}')\n        \n        # Convert to X,Y coordinates\n        for pos in diff_positions[:10]:\n            x = pos % 320\n            y = pos // 320\n            old_val = frame0[pos]\n            new_val = frame7[pos]\n            print(f'  ({x},{y}): {old_val} -&gt;   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract and save the Egypt flight path animation overlay from ALFRED.7\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.7', 'rb') as f:\n    a7_data = f.read()\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\ndef va_to_file_data(va):\n    return va - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n\ndef decompress_rle(data):\n    \"\"\"Decompress RLE data until BUDA marker\"\"\"\n    output = []\n    pos = 0\n    while pos &lt; len(data) - 1:\n        count = data[pos]\n        value = data[pos + 1]\n        \n        if count == 0x42 and value == 0x55:  # BUDA start\n            break\n        \n        if count == 0:\n            pos += 2\n            continue\n        \n        output.extend([value] * count)\n        pos += 2\n        \n        if len(output) &gt; 65000:\n            break\n    \n    return bytes(output)\n\nprint('=' * 70)\nprint('EXTRACTING EGYPT FLIGHT PATH ANIMATION')\nprint('=' * 70)\n\n# The Egypt map palette\npalette_offset = 0xDE011\npalette = a7_data[palette_offset:palette_offset+768]\n\n# The animation overlay at 0x2DE14A\noverlay_offset = 0x2DE14A\noverlay_data = a7_data[overlay_offset:overlay_offset+32000]\noverlay_decompressed = decompress_rle(overlay_data)\n\nprint(f'Overlay decompressed size: {len(overlay_decompressed)} bytes')\n\n# Save as PNG using lodepng-style raw format\nimport os\nos.makedirs('output_egypt', exist_ok=True)\n\n# Create a simple PPM image for visualization\nwidth = 320\nheight = 200\n\n# Get the actual colors used (excluding 0xFF which is transparent)\ncolor_set = set(overlay_decompressed[:64000])\nprint(f'Colors used: {sorted(color_set)}')\n\n# Map palette indices to RGB\ndef get_rgb(idx):\n    r = palette[idx*3] * 4  # VGA 6-bit to 8-bit\n    g = palette[idx*3+1] * 4\n    b = palette[idx*3+2] * 4\n    return (r, g, b)\n\nprint('\\nColor palette mapping:')\nfor idx in sorted(color_set):\n    r, g, b = get_rgb(idx)\n    print(f'  Index {idx}: RGB({r}, {g}, {b})')\n\n# Create PPM image\nwith open('output_egypt/flight_path_overlay.ppm', 'wb') as f:\n    # PPM header\n    f.write(f'P6\\n{width}
